    for side, (ladder, en) in enumerate([(RANK_ORDINAL_HABSBURG, RANK_EN_HABSBURG),
                                         (RANK_ORDINAL_LEGION, RANK_EN_LEGION)]):
        for name in ladder:
            g = RANK_COMMON.get(name)
            if g is None:
                unmapped["Habsburg" if side == 0 else "Legion"].append(name)
                continue
            by_grade.setdefault(g, ([], []))[side].append((name, en.get(name, name)))

    RH, BW, GW, PADT = 27, 232, 76, 74
    HX, GX = 30, 30 + 232 + 74
    LXX = GX + GW + 74
    W = LXX + BW + 34                                  # room for the outer grade numerals
    grades = sorted(by_grade, reverse=True)
    ytop: dict[int, int] = {}
    y = PADT
    for g in grades:
        ytop[g] = y
        y += max(len(by_grade[g][0]), len(by_grade[g][1]), 1) * RH + 6
    H = y + 16

    nmax = max([*hn.values(), *ln.values()], default=1)

    def _box(side: int, name: str, en: str, x: int, yy: int, grade: int) -> str:
        n = (hn if side == 0 else ln).get(name, 0)
        nc = name in NONCOMBAT_STATUS and side == 1
        senior = grade >= SENIOR_FROM
        cls = ("rkbox" + (" zero" if not n else "") + (" nc" if nc else "")
               + (" snr" if senior and n else ""))
        bar = (BW - 16) * (n ** .5 / nmax ** .5) if n else 0
        lab = f"{n:,}" if n else "0"
        # The fine common grade as a bare numeral, on the OUTER edge of each ladder — the
        # inner edges are where the connector fan attaches, so a number there would sit in
        # the lines. Left of the Habsburg boxes, right of the Legion ones.
        num = (f'<text class="rkg out" x="-9" y="15">{grade}</text>' if side == 0
               else f'<text class="rkg" x="{BW + 9}" y="15">{grade}</text>')
        return (f'<g class="{cls}" data-g="{grade}" data-name="{_html.escape(name)}" '
                f'data-side="{"h" if side == 0 else "l"}" transform="translate({x},{yy})" '
                'onclick="rkPick(this)">'
                f'<rect width="{BW}" height="{RH - 5}" rx="4"/>'
                + (f'<rect class="rkbar" x="8" y="{RH - 10}" width="{bar:.0f}" height="2.5"/>'
                   if bar else "")
                + num
                + f'<text class="rkcs" x="10" y="15">{_html.escape(name)}</text>'
                f'<text class="rkn" x="{BW - 10}" y="15">{lab}</text>'
                f'<title>{_html.escape(en)} — common grade {grade} '
                f'({_COMMON_TO_BAND.get(grade, "—")}) · n = {lab}</title></g>')

    svg = [f'<svg id="rksvg" viewBox="0 0 {W} {H}" width="{W}" height="{H}" '
           'xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><defs>'
           '<pattern id="rkhatch" width="6" height="6" patternTransform="rotate(45)" '
           'patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse"><line x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="6" '
           'stroke="#d0687a" stroke-width="2.2" opacity=".45"/></pattern></defs>',
           f'<text class="rkhead" x="{HX}" y="30">HABSBURG LADDER</text>',
           f'<text class="rksub" x="{HX}" y="48">rank at capture</text>',
           f'<text class="rkhead" x="{GX - 6}" y="30">NATO BAND</text>',
           f'<text class="rksub" x="{GX - 6}" y="48">one rung per grade</text>',
           f'<text class="rkhead" x="{LXX}" y="30">LEGION LADDER</text>',
           f'<text class="rksub" x="{LXX}" y="48">rank on enrolment</text>']

    # Connectors. Each runs between a rank box (at its own row, ry) and the grade pill (at the
    # band's centre, gy) — so the y endpoints are ordered by DIRECTION, not by column: the left
    # lane leaves a box and arrives at the pill, the right lane leaves the pill and arrives at a
    # box. Using one order for both mirrored the right-hand fan.
    svg.append('<g id="rkedges">')
    for g in grades:
        gy = ytop[g] + max(len(by_grade[g][0]), len(by_grade[g][1]), 1) * RH / 2 - 3
        for side, (x1, x2) in ((0, (HX + BW, GX)), (1, (GX + GW, LXX))):
            for i, _ in enumerate(by_grade[g][side]):
                ry = ytop[g] + i * RH + (RH - 5) / 2
                ya, yb = (ry, gy) if side == 0 else (gy, ry)
                mx = (x1 + x2) / 2
                svg.append(f'<path class="rkedge" data-g="{g}" d="M{x1},{ya:.0f} '
                           f'C{mx:.0f},{ya:.0f} {mx:.0f},{yb:.0f} {x2},{yb:.0f}"/>')
    svg.append("</g>")

    for g in grades:
        rowsn = max(len(by_grade[g][0]), len(by_grade[g][1]), 1)
        gy = ytop[g] + rowsn * RH / 2 - 3
        svg.append(f'<g class="rkgrade" data-g="{g}" transform="translate({GX},{gy - 11:.0f})">'
                   f'<rect width="{GW}" height="22" rx="11"/>'
                   f'<text x="{GW / 2:.0f}" y="15">{_COMMON_TO_BAND.get(g, "—")}</text></g>')
        for side, x in ((0, HX), (1, LXX)):
            for i, (name, en) in enumerate(by_grade[g][side]):
                svg.append(_box(side, name, en, x, ytop[g] + i * RH, g))
    svg.append("</svg>")

    foot = ""
    if any(unmapped.values()):
        bits = "; ".join(f"{k}: " + ", ".join(f"<code>{_html.escape(v)}</code>" for v in vs)
                         for k, vs in unmapped.items() if vs)
        foot = ('<p class="note"><b>Not on the common scale.</b> These ranks carry a within-army '
                f"ordinal but no common grade, so no reset can be computed for them — {bits}.</p>")

    return (
        ix_head("The two ladders, and what the reset subtracts", ix=True, hover=True)
        + '<p class="note">Left, the k.u.k. ladder a man was on when he was captured; right, the '
        "Legion ladder he entered on. Neither army's own numbering can be subtracted from the "
        "other's, so both are pinned to one <b>common scale</b> down the middle, on which the same "
        "Czech word always scores the same rung — and <code>rank_reset</code> is nothing more than "
        "the step between the two. Each rung is labelled with its <b>NATO band</b> "
        "(APersP-01), which is the coarse robustness axis; where consecutive rungs carry the same "
        "band the band cannot tell them apart, and the three subaltern rungs all reading "
        "<b>OF-1</b> is exactly why the fine scale exists — the bare numeral on each ladder's "
        "outer edge is that finer rung. <b>Hover</b> a rank to light its rung and its counterpart "
        "in the other army. <b>Click</b> either side: a Habsburg rank shows where those men went, "
        "a Legion rank shows where they came from. Bars are √n; counts are from "
        "<code>data/final</code>.</p>"
        '<p class="note"><b>One rung is contested.</b> <i>svobodník</i> is coded <b>OR-3</b> here, '
        "but §G2 above reports the APersP-01 CZE note as <i>vojín, svobodník</i> = OR-1, and "
        "Bednařík's 1916 POW-camp pay anchor pays “pěšák a svobodník 15” — private and "
        "svobodník identically, with the first real step at <i>desátník</i>/<i>četař</i>. The band "
        "axis for the enlisted rungs is therefore the weakest part of this figure; it is logged as "
        "an open item in <a href='#decisions'>Decisions</a> (D-15) and affects only "
        "<code>rank_band</code>, not the headline <code>rank_reset</code>, which rides on the "
        "numeral rather than the band.</p>"
        '<div class="rkbar-legend"><span class="rklg"><span class="sw nc"></span>non-combat status '
        "(<code>legion_noncombat</code>) — scored at grade 1, but not a demotion</span>"
        '<span class="rklg"><span class="sw zero"></span>in the ladder, absent from the data'
        "</span>"
        '<span class="rklg"><span class="sw snr"></span>OF-3 and above — click for the individual '
        "records</span></div>"
        f"<script>window.RKDEST={json.dumps(dest, ensure_ascii=False)};"
        f"window.RKORIG={json.dumps(orig, ensure_ascii=False)};"
        f"window.RKROSTER={json.dumps(roster, ensure_ascii=False)};"
        f"window.RKSENIOR={SENIOR_FROM};</script>"
        f'<div class="rklayout"><div class="rkwrap">{"".join(svg)}</div>'
        '<aside class="rkpanel empty" id="rkpanel"><p class="pnote">Click either ladder. A '
        "<b>Habsburg</b> rank shows where those men went; a <b>Legion</b> rank shows where they "
        "came from. At <b>OF-3 and above</b> the panel lists the individual records, each linking "
        "to its csol.cz entry.</p></aside></div>"
        + foot + "<hr>")


_REGX_JS = """
(function(){
  const root=document.getElementById('regx'); if(!root) return;
  const tbody=root.querySelector('tbody'), q=document.getElementById('regxq'),
        cnt=document.getElementById('regxcount');
  const rows=[...tbody.querySelectorAll('tr')]; const filt={branch:'',lang:''};
  function apply(){
    const s=(q.value||'').toLowerCase().trim(); let n=0;
    rows.forEach(r=>{ let ok=(!s||r.textContent.toLowerCase().includes(s));
      for(const g in filt){ if(filt[g] && r.dataset[g]!==filt[g]) ok=false; }
      r.style.display=ok?'':'none'; if(ok)n++; });
    cnt.textContent=n+' / '+rows.length+' units';
  }
  root.querySelectorAll('.regxchip').forEach(c=>c.addEventListener('click',()=>{
    const g=c.dataset.g;
    root.querySelectorAll('.regxchip[data-g=\"'+g+'\"]').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('on'));
    c.classList.add('on'); filt[g]=c.dataset.v; apply();
  }));
  q.addEventListener('input',apply);
  root.querySelectorAll('th[data-sort]').forEach((th,i)=>th.addEventListener('click',()=>{
    const num=th.dataset.sort==='n'; const dir=th._d=(th._d===1?-1:1);
    const vis=rows.filter(r=>r.style.display!=='none');
    vis.sort((a,b)=>{ const A=a.children[i],B=b.children[i];
      let x=num?parseFloat(A.dataset.s||A.textContent):A.textContent.toLowerCase();
      let y=num?parseFloat(B.dataset.s||B.textContent):B.textContent.toLowerCase();
      return (x<y?-1:x>y?1:0)*dir; });
    vis.forEach(r=>tbody.appendChild(r));
  }));
  apply();
})();
"""


_ARM_BRANCH = {
    "Feldjäger": "Feldjäger", "Landesschützen": "Infantry",
    "Dragoner": "Cavalry", "Husar": "Cavalry", "Ulan": "Cavalry",
    "Landwehr-Ulan": "Cavalry", "Honvéd-Husar": "Cavalry",
    "Feldkanonen": "Artillery", "Feldhaubitz": "Artillery", "reitende Artillerie": "Artillery",
    "schwere Haubitz": "Artillery", "Gebirgsartillerie": "Artillery",
    "Festungsartillerie": "Artillery", "Landwehr-Feldkanonen": "Artillery",
    "Landwehr-Feldhaubitz": "Artillery", "Landwehr-Artillerie": "Artillery",
    "Honvéd-Artillerie": "Artillery",
    "Sappeur": "Technical", "Pionier": "Technical", "Train": "Technical",
    "Verkehrstruppen": "Technical", "Brücken": "Technical",
}


def _regiment_explorer() -> str:
    """Interactive filter/search/sort table of the complete Tabelle I order of battle
    (infantry + cavalry/artillery/Feldjäger/technical), appended to the Habsburg-army sheet."""

    def _num(x):
        try:
            return int(round(float(x)))
        except Exception:
            return 0

    def _dist(r):
        d = r.get("okres_cs")
        if d is None or (isinstance(d, float) and pd.isna(d)) or not str(d).strip():
            d = r.get("sk_jaras")
        return "—" if (d is None or (isinstance(d, float) and pd.isna(d))
                       or not str(d).strip()) else str(d)

    recs, n_inf = [], 0                                   # (branch, type, no, erg, lang, cz, hom, dist)
    for pil, fn in [("common", "ehnl_tabelle1_infantry.csv"),
                    ("Landwehr", "ehnl_tabelle1_landwehr.csv"),
                    ("Honvéd", "ehnl_tabelle1_honved.csv"),
                    ("special", "ehnl_tabelle1_special.csv")]:
        p = ROOT / "reference" / "units" / fn
        if not p.exists():
            continue
        for _, r in pd.read_csv(p).iterrows():
            recs.append(("Infantry", pil, str(r["reg_no"]),
                         str(r.get("ergbez_modern") or r.get("ergbez") or "—"),
                         str(r.get("dominant_lang") or "—"),
                         _num(r.get("pct_czech")), _num(r.get("dominant_share")), _dist(r)))
            n_inf += 1
    oob = ROOT / "reference" / "units" / "ehnl_tabelle1_other.csv"
    if oob.exists():
        for _, r in pd.read_csv(oob).iterrows():
            arm = str(r.get("arm") or "—")
            recs.append((_ARM_BRANCH.get(arm, "Other"), arm, str(r.get("reg_no") or ""),
                         str(r.get("ergbez_modern") or r.get("ergbez") or "—"),
                         str(r.get("dominant_lang") or "—"),
                         _num(r.get("pct_czech")), _num(r.get("dominant_share")), _dist(r)))
    if not recs:
        return ""
    langs = sorted({x[4] for x in recs if x[4] and x[4] != "—"})

    def _chips(group, values):
        out = [f'<button class="regxchip on" data-g="{group}" data-v="">All</button>']
        for v in values:
            out.append(f'<button class="regxchip" data-g="{group}" data-v="{_html.escape(v)}">'
                       f'{_html.escape(v)}</button>')
        return "".join(out)

    def _sortkey(no):
        s = str(no)
        return _num(s) if s.lstrip("-").isdigit() else 0

    body = "".join(
        f'<tr data-branch="{_html.escape(br)}" data-lang="{_html.escape(lang)}">'
        f'<td>{_html.escape(br)}</td><td>{_html.escape(typ)}</td>'
        f'<td data-s="{_sortkey(no)}">{_html.escape(str(no))}</td>'
        f'<td>{_html.escape(erg)}</td><td>{_html.escape(lang)}</td>'
        f'<td data-s="{cz}">{cz}</td><td data-s="{hom}">{hom}</td>'
        f'<td>{_html.escape(dist)}</td></tr>'
        for br, typ, no, erg, lang, cz, hom, dist in recs)
    head = ('<tr><th data-sort="t">Branch</th><th data-sort="t">Type</th><th data-sort="n">No.</th>'
            '<th data-sort="t">Recruiting district</th><th data-sort="t">Dominant language</th>'
            '<th data-sort="n">% Czech</th><th data-sort="n">Homogeneity&nbsp;%</th>'
            '<th data-sort="t">1910 district</th></tr>')
    return (
        "<hr>" + ix_head(f"Explore the complete order of battle — {len(recs)} units",
                         ix=True, attrs='id="regx-explore"')
        + f'<p class="note">Every 1914 unit from Ehnl’s <i>Tabelle I</i> — {n_inf} infantry regiments plus '
        f'{len(recs) - n_inf} cavalry, artillery, Feldjäger and technical units. Filter by <b>branch</b> '
        'or <b>dominant language</b>, search a district or type, or click a column header to sort. '
        'Infantry regiments carry a recruiting district; cavalry and artillery were <i>corps-recruited</i> '
        '(no single district — “—”). “Homogeneity&nbsp;%” is the dominant language’s share. Try '
        '<i>branch = Infantry</i> + <i>language = Czech</i> for the regiments that produced the most '
        'legionnaires.</p>'
        '<div class="regx" id="regx"><div class="regxbar"><span class="regxlbl">Branch</span>'
        + _chips("branch", ["Infantry", "Feldjäger", "Cavalry", "Artillery", "Technical"])
        + '<span class="regxlbl">Language</span>' + _chips("lang", langs)
        + '<input id="regxq" class="regxq" placeholder="search district / type…">'
        '<span class="regxcount" id="regxcount"></span></div>'
        '<div class="tblwrap"><table class="tbl regxtbl"><thead>' + head
        + '</thead><tbody>' + body + '</tbody></table></div></div>'
        + f'<script>{_REGX_JS}</script>')


def units_sheet() -> str:
    """The 'How it works' explainer for unit identity — prose + live numbers.

    Written after the Fidler validation added ``legion_army`` / ``unit_key`` and the
    unit-authority cross-check. Everything numeric is recomputed from ``data/final`` so
    the explanation and the data cannot drift apart.
    """
    L = pd.read_parquet(FIN / "persons" / "legionnaires_clean.parquet")
    f = _legion_flags(L)
    N = len(L)
    n_army = L["legion_army"].nunique(dropna=True)
    n_reg = L["regiment"].nunique(dropna=True)
    n_key = L["unit_key"].nunique(dropna=True)
    foreign = int((L["legion_army"].notna()
                   & ~L["legion_army"].astype("string").str.startswith("CS Legion", na=False)).sum())

    # army breakdown
    army = (L["legion_army"].value_counts(dropna=False).rename_axis("Army / formation")
            .reset_index(name="Records"))
    army["Army / formation"] = army["Army / formation"].fillna("— (none recorded)")
    army["%"] = (army["Records"] / N * 100).map("{:.1f}%".format)
    army["Records"] = army["Records"].map("{:,}".format)

    # verification status
    lab = {"match": "Verified — number exists in this theatre",
           "no-entry": "No Fidler entry for this number",
           "conflict": "Conflict — number never existed in this theatre",
           "n-a": "Not checkable (support unit / foreign army / no number)"}
    vs = f["unit_status"].value_counts()
    vrows = []
    for k in ["match", "no-entry", "conflict", "n-a"]:
        n = int(vs.get(k, 0))
        d = int((f["deserted"] & (f["unit_status"] == k)).sum())
        vrows.append({"Status": lab[k], "Records": f"{n:,}", "% of records": _pct(n, N),
                      "Deserters": f"{d:,}"})

    # the conflicts, concretely
    cf = L[f["unit_status"] == "conflict"]
    ct = (cf.groupby(["regiment", "theater"]).size().rename("Records")
          .reset_index().sort_values("Records", ascending=False).head(12))
    ct = ct.rename(columns={"regiment": "Regiment label", "theater": "Tagged theatre"})
    ct["Records"] = ct["Records"].map("{:,}".format)

    return _with_toc(
        "<h2>Unit identity — regiment, army, and unit_key</h2>"
        '<p class="note">The raw enrolment field is <code>label ( formation )</code>, e.g. '
        "<code>1.stř.pl. ( Čs. legie v Rusku )</code>. The parenthetical is the part that is "
        "easy to misread: it names an <b>army</b>, not merely a theatre. Regiment numbering "
        "restarts inside each army, so the bare number is <b>not</b> a unit identifier.</p>"
        f'<p class="note">Across the {N:,} records there are <b>{n_army}</b> distinct armies / '
        f"formations. <b>{foreign:,}</b> records ({_pct(foreign, N)}) sit under a "
        "<b>non-Czechoslovak</b> army — the French Foreign Legion (whose 1st regiment, "
        "<i>rota Nazdar</i> included, is <b>not</b> the Czechoslovak 1st Rifle), the French, "
        "Serbian, Russian and British armies. Collapsing on <code>regiment</code> alone would "
        "merge those with Legion units of the same number.</p>"
        + df_table(army)
        + "<h2>The three columns, and which to use</h2>"
        "<table class='tbl'><thead><tr><th>Column</th><th>What it is</th><th>Use for</th></tr>"
        "</thead><tbody>"
        f"<tr><td><code>regiment</code></td><td>display label, army stripped "
        f"({n_reg:,} distinct)</td><td>reading, plot facets</td></tr>"
        "<tr><td><code>legion_army</code></td><td>the formation, normalised</td>"
        "<td>splitting Legion from foreign service</td></tr>"
        f"<tr><td><code>unit_key</code></td><td><code>regiment @ army</code> "
        f"({n_key:,} distinct identities)</td><td><b>unit fixed effects, clustering, size "
        "denominators</b></td></tr></tbody></table>"
        f'<p class="note">{n_reg:,} labels resolve into {n_key:,} distinct '
        "<code>unit_key</code> identities — the gap is the regiment numbers shared across "
        "armies. See <a href='#pipeline'>Pipeline → units.py</a> and "
        "<a href='#variables'>Variables §5</a>.</p>"
        "<h2>Which units actually existed — the Fidler cross-check</h2>"
        "<p class='note'>Every Czechoslovak-Legion record whose regiment carries a number is "
        "checked against <a href='#unit-authority'>the unit authority</a> derived from Fidler "
        "(2025): did that regiment number exist in the theatre the record claims? Support "
        "companies, foreign-army units and unnumbered formations carry no number to check and "
        "are marked <i>not checkable</i> — that is not the same as wrong.</p>"
        + df_table(pd.DataFrame(vrows))
        + "<p class='note'>The <b>conflicts</b> are records whose regiment number never "
        "existed in the tagged theatre — the 21st–23rd rifle regiments were French, the "
        "31st–39th Italian, yet a handful are tagged Russia. These are contradictions "
        "<b>inside csol.cz</b>, reproduced rather than silently corrected, and flagged by a "
        "soft QA check. The <a href='#validation'>validation sheet</a> has the full account.</p>"
        + df_table(ct)
        + "<h2>What this feeds</h2>"
        "<p class='note'>The <a href='#descriptives'>Descriptives → analysis sample</a> "
        "waterfall lets you require a verified unit (or merely a non-contradicted one) and see "
        "the cost in sample size — the borderline decision this cross-check exists to inform.</p>",
        "units")


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Live descriptives
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
def live_sheets() -> tuple[str, str]:
    """Build the two data-driven sheets — ``(descriptives, qa)`` — from ``data/final``.

    Everything here is computed at build time; no figure is transcribed. The QA half
    re-runs the invariants that correspond to bugs which were once real in this project
    (frame exclusivity, cross-frame attribute leakage, fabricated exit codes, coordinate
    accuracy), so a regression shows up as a red row rather than as silently wrong prose.

    Returns:
        ``(descriptives_html, qa_html)``.
    """
    from utils.parsing.exit_codes import CODES_CS, CODES_EN, parse_exit_codes

    L = pd.read_parquet(FIN / "persons" / "legionnaires_clean.parquet")
    H = pd.read_parquet(FIN / "persons" / "habsburg_clean.parquet")
    cen = pd.read_parquet(FIN / "census" / "census_okres_1910.parquet")
    _cen_pool_p = FIN / "census" / "census_okres_1910_pooled.parquet"
    cen_pool = pd.read_parquet(_cen_pool_p) if _cen_pool_p.exists() else None
    cen_hu = pd.read_parquet(FIN / "census" / "census_hu_jaras_1910.parquet")
    setl = pd.read_parquet(FIN / "geo" / "settlements_1910.parquet")
    setl_hu = pd.read_parquet(FIN / "geo" / "settlements_hu_1910.parquet")
    dist = pd.read_parquet(FIN / "geo" / "districts_1910.parquet")
    dist_hu = pd.read_parquet(FIN / "geo" / "districts_hu_1910.parquet")
    match = pd.read_csv(FIN / "persons" / "overlap_matches.csv")

    S: list[str] = []

    # ── datasets
    S.append("<h2>Datasets</h2>")
    S.append(df_table(pd.DataFrame([
        {"File": "persons/legionnaires_clean", "Unit": "legionnaire", "Rows": f"{len(L):,}", "Columns": L.shape[1]},
        {"File": "persons/habsburg_clean", "Unit": "fallen Habsburg soldier", "Rows": f"{len(H):,}", "Columns": H.shape[1]},
        {"File": "census/census_okres_1910", "Unit": "1910 political okres", "Rows": f"{len(cen):,}", "Columns": cen.shape[1]},
    ] + ([{"File": "census/census_okres_1910_pooled", "Unit": "1910 okres, city/rural twins pooled",
           "Rows": f"{len(cen_pool):,}", "Columns": cen_pool.shape[1]}] if cen_pool is not None else []) + [
        {"File": "census/census_hu_jaras_1910", "Unit": "1910 járás / town", "Rows": f"{len(cen_hu):,}", "Columns": cen_hu.shape[1]},
        {"File": "geo/districts_1910", "Unit": "court district", "Rows": f"{len(dist):,}", "Columns": dist.shape[1]},
        {"File": "geo/districts_hu_1910", "Unit": "járás / town", "Rows": f"{len(dist_hu):,}", "Columns": dist_hu.shape[1]},
        {"File": "geo/settlements_1910", "Unit": "Czech settlement", "Rows": f"{len(setl):,}", "Columns": setl.shape[1]},
        {"File": "geo/settlements_hu_1910", "Unit": "Slovak obec", "Rows": f"{len(setl_hu):,}", "Columns": setl_hu.shape[1]},
        {"File": "persons/overlap_matches", "Unit": "confirmed overlap", "Rows": f"{len(match):,}", "Columns": match.shape[1]},
    ])))

    # ── analysis-sample waterfalls (interactive) — legionnaires + Habsburg comparison
    S.append(waterfall_block(L, _legion_flags(L)))
    S.append(waterfall_block_habsburg(H))

    # ── outcome
    S.append("<h2>Outcome — exit from the Legions</h2>")
    rows = []
    for c in CODES_CS:
        n = int(L[f"exit_{c}"].sum())
        rows.append({"Code": c, "Meaning": CODES_EN[c], "n": f"{n:,}", "% of records": _pct(n, len(L))})
    nocode = int((L["exit_codes"].isna() | (L["exit_codes"].astype(str) == "")).sum())
    rows.append({"Code": "—", "Meaning": "No code recorded (censored)", "n": f"{nocode:,}",
                 "% of records": _pct(nocode, len(L))})
    S.append(df_table(pd.DataFrame(rows)))
    S.append(f'<p class="note"><b>D (deserted) = {int(L["deserted"].sum()):,}</b> is the primary '
             "outcome. Records with no exit code carry no outcome information and must be treated "
             "as <b>censored</b>, not as non-desertion.</p>")

    # ── desertion by theatre
    if "theater" in L:
        g = (L.groupby("theater").agg(n=("deserted", "size"), d=("deserted", "sum"))
             .sort_values("n", ascending=False).reset_index())
        g["Desertion rate"] = (g["d"] / g["n"] * 100).map("{:.2f}%".format)
        g = g.rename(columns={"theater": "Theatre", "n": "Legionnaires", "d": "Deserted"})
        g["Legionnaires"] = g["Legionnaires"].map("{:,}".format)
        g["Deserted"] = g["Deserted"].map("{:,}".format)
        S.append("<h2>Desertion by theatre</h2>")
        S.append(df_table(g))

    # ── rank reset
    if "rank_reset" in L:
        # the view toggle below belongs to this section, so the section heading carries the
        # chip — the toolbar itself must not (a chip in a toolbar is invisible to a reader
        # scanning headings, which is how this drifted in the first place)
        S.append(ix_head("Rank reset (headline regressor)",
                         ix="legion_noncombat" in L.columns, hover=True))
        rows = []
        for lab, col in [("Fine (ALT-1 common scale)", "rank_reset"),
                         ("Coarse (NATO OF/OR band)", "rank_reset_band")]:
            if col not in L:
                continue
            r = L[col].dropna()
            rows.append({"Measure": lab, "N resolved": f"{len(r):,}",
                         "Demoted": _pct((r < 0).sum(), len(r)),
                         "Unchanged": _pct((r == 0).sum(), len(r)),
                         "Promoted": _pct((r > 0).sum(), len(r)),
                         "Mean": f"{r.mean():.2f}"})
        S.append(df_table(pd.DataFrame(rows)))
        # combat-ranks-only view (default) vs the inclusive view. `legion_noncombat`
        # marks pracovník/občan entry statuses whose reset is an artifact (see the
        # Rank ladders sheet §H#1 / External validation §3); the toggle switches both
        # the histogram and the by-theatre areas between the two.
        if "legion_noncombat" in L.columns:
            combat = ~L["legion_noncombat"].fillna(False).astype(bool)
            n_nc = int((~combat).sum())
            S.append(
                '<div class="rrsec combatonly" id="rrsec">'
                '<div class="rrmodebar"><span class="h">Rank-reset view:</span>'
                '<button class="rrmode on" onclick="rrMode(this,\'combat\')">Combat ranks only</button>'
                '<button class="rrmode" onclick="rrMode(this,\'all\')">Include labour / civilian status</button>'
                f'<span class="rrmodenote">{n_nc:,} records carry a non-combat entry '
                "status (pracovník / občan); their reset differences a status against a "
                "rank and is shown only in the inclusive view.</span></div>"
                '<div class="rrvar rr-combat">' + rank_reset_hist(L, combat) + "</div>"
                '<div class="rrvar rr-all">' + rank_reset_hist(L, None) + "</div>"
                + ix_head("Rank reset by theatre", ix=True, hover=True)
                + '<div class="rrvar rr-combat">' + rank_reset_areas(L, mask=combat) + "</div>"
                '<div class="rrvar rr-all">' + rank_reset_areas(L, mask=None) + "</div>"
                "</div>")
        else:
            S.append(rank_reset_hist(L))
            S.append("<h2>Rank reset by theatre</h2>" + rank_reset_areas(L))

    # ── place matching
    S.append("<h2>Place matching — birth</h2>")
    rows = []
    for nm, d in (("Legionnaires", L), ("Habsburg fallen", H)):
        rows.append({
            "Dataset": nm, "Rows": f"{len(d):,}",
            "Czech okres_id": f"{int(d['birth_okres_id'].notna().sum()):,} ({_pct(int(d['birth_okres_id'].notna().sum()), len(d))})",
            "Slovak jaras_id": f"{int(d['birth_jaras_id'].notna().sum()):,} ({_pct(int(d['birth_jaras_id'].notna().sum()), len(d))})",
            "Court district": f"{int(d['birth_court_id'].notna().sum()):,}",
            "Coordinates": f"{int(d['birth_lat'].notna().sum()):,}",
        })
    S.append(df_table(pd.DataFrame(rows)))
    tiers = pd.DataFrame({
        "Legionnaires": L["birth_okres_match"].value_counts(),
        "Habsburg fallen": H["birth_okres_match"].value_counts(),
    }).fillna(0).astype(int).rename_axis("Czech tier").reset_index()
    tiers["Czech tier"] = tiers["Czech tier"].astype(str)
    S.append(df_table(tiers))
    tiers_sk = pd.DataFrame({
        "Legionnaires": L["birth_jaras_match"].value_counts(),
        "Habsburg fallen": H["birth_jaras_match"].value_counts(),
    }).fillna(0).astype(int).rename_axis("Slovak tier").reset_index()
    tiers_sk["Slovak tier"] = tiers_sk["Slovak tier"].astype(str)
    S.append(df_table(tiers_sk))
    S.append('<p class="note">Tiers are ordered strongest → weakest; <code>muni</code> and '
             "<code>fuzzy</code> are the soft ones a strict specification can drop. A record is "
             "placed in <b>at most one</b> 1910 frame.</p>")

    # ── linkage
    S.append("<h2>Cross-dataset linkage</h2>")
    lk = (match["confidence"].value_counts().rename_axis("Confidence")
          .reset_index(name="Pairs"))
    lk["Evidence"] = lk["Confidence"].map({"high": "Exact full date of birth + matching name",
                                           "medium": "VÚA legion note + birth okres + year + name"})
    S.append(df_table(lk[["Confidence", "Evidence", "Pairs"]]))
    S.append(f'<p class="note">{len(match):,} confirmed overlaps over '
             f'{match["vua_id"].nunique():,} distinct VÚA records; '
             f'{int((match["date_exact"] & match["note_legion"]).sum()):,} satisfy both criteria. '
             "The rule is precision-first: weaker name/year coincidences are dropped, not down-tiered.</p>")

    # ── coverage of key variables
    S.append("<h2>Coverage of key variables</h2>")
    keys = [("birth_date", "Date of birth"), ("birth_year", "Year of birth"),
            ("birth_okres", "Birth district (raw)"), ("education", "Education"),
            ("occupation", "Occupation"), ("religion", "Religion"),
            ("habsburg_rank", "Habsburg rank at capture"), ("legion_rank", "Legion rank at enrolment"),
            ("enroll_date", "Enrolment date"), ("exit_date", "Exit date"),
            ("death_date", "Date of death"), ("cause", "Cause of death")]
    rows = []
    for col, lab in keys:
        a = _pct(int(L[col].notna().sum()), len(L)) if col in L else "—"
        b = _pct(int(H[col].notna().sum()), len(H)) if col in H else "—"
        rows.append({"Variable": lab, "Column": col, "Legionnaires": a, "Habsburg fallen": b})
    S.append(df_table(pd.DataFrame(rows)))

    # ── figures
    S.append("<h2>Figures</h2>")
    S.append('<p class="note">Generated by <code>notebooks/03_visualisation.ipynb</code>; '
             "PDF and beamer variants of each live in <code>output/figures/</code>.</p>")
    figs = sorted(p for p in ROOT.joinpath("output", "figures").rglob("*.png")
                  if "_beamer" not in p.name)
    groups: dict[str, list[Path]] = {}
    for f in figs:
        groups.setdefault(f.parent.parent.name.replace("descriptives_habsburg", "Habsburg fallen")
                          .replace("descriptives", "Legionnaires"), []).append(f)
    for grp, items in groups.items():
        S.append(f"<h3>{_html.escape(grp)}</h3><div class='figgrid'>")
        for f in items:
            b64 = base64.b64encode(f.read_bytes()).decode()
            cap = f.stem.replace("_", " ").capitalize()
            S.append(f'<figure><img src="data:image/png;base64,{b64}" alt="{_html.escape(cap)}" '
                     f'onclick="zoom(this)" title="Click to enlarge">'
                     f"<figcaption>{_html.escape(cap)}<br><code>{f.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()}</code>"
                     "</figcaption></figure>")
        S.append("</div>")

    # ══ QA sheet ══ — the invariants themselves live in utils/validation/data_checks.py,
    # which notebook 02 also calls as a gate, so the page and the pipeline cannot disagree.
    from utils.validation.data_checks import run_checks

    Q: list[str] = []
    checks = run_checks(FIN)
    npass = sum(c.ok for c in checks)
    hard_bad = sum(1 for c in checks if not c.ok and c.hard)

    Q.append(f'<h2>Invariants <span class="{"ok" if npass==len(checks) else "bad"}">'
             f"{npass}/{len(checks)} passing</span></h2>")
    Q.append('<p class="note">Defined once in <code>utils/validation/data_checks.py</code> and '
             "evaluated against the current <code>data/final</code> every time this page is built. "
             "Notebook 02 calls the same list as its final cell, so a run that produced broken data "
             "<b>fails</b> rather than reporting success. Each check corresponds to a bug that was "
             "real at some point in this project — see the "
             "<a href='#audit'>audits</a> of 2026-07-16 and 2026-09-22.<br>"
             "<b>FAIL</b> is a hard invariant that should never be violated; <b>WARN</b> is a soft "
             "one (it can drift for external reasons) that reports but does not block.</p>")
    Q.append('<div class="tblwrap"><table class="tbl qa"><thead><tr><th></th><th>Check</th>'
             "<th>If it fails</th></tr></thead><tbody>")
    for c in checks:
        badge = ('<span class="badge pass">PASS</span>' if c.ok else
                 '<span class="badge fail">FAIL</span>' if c.hard else
                 '<span class="badge warn">WARN</span>')
        Q.append(f"<tr><td>{badge}</td><td>{_html.escape(c.label)}"
                 + ("" if c.hard else ' <span class="soft">soft</span>')
                 + f'</td><td class="muted">{_html.escape(c.detail)}</td></tr>')
    Q.append("</tbody></table></div>")
    return _with_toc("\n".join(S), "desc"), "\n".join(Q), hard_bad



# Libertinus faces embedded as base64 so the page looks the same on every machine.
_FONT_FACES = [("Libertinus Sans", 400, "normal", "LibertinusSans-Regular"),
               ("Libertinus Sans", 400, "italic", "LibertinusSans-Italic"),
               ("Libertinus Sans", 700, "normal", "LibertinusSans-Bold"),
               ("Libertinus Serif", 700, "normal", "LibertinusSerif-Bold")]


def _font_face_css() -> str:
    """@font-face rules for the subset fonts in utils/docs/fonts (made by build_fonts.py)."""
    fonts = Path(__file__).parent / "fonts"
    rules = []
    for family, weight, style, stem in _FONT_FACES:
        b64 = base64.b64encode((fonts / f"{stem}.woff").read_bytes()).decode()
        rules.append(f"@font-face{{font-family:'{family}';font-weight:{weight};font-style:{style};"
                     f"font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff;base64,{b64}) format('woff')}}")
    return "\n".join(rules)

          overflow:auto;background:#fdfdfe}

           padding:14px 15px;font:13px/1.5 var(--sans);overflow:auto;max-height:640px;
           position:sticky;top:12px;align-self:flex-start}
.archpanel .aempty{color:var(--grey);font-size:12.5px}
.archpanel h3{margin:0 0 2px;font:600 16px var(--sans);color:var(--navy);word-break:break-word}
.archpanel .arole{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font:11.5px var(--sans);
                  color:#41474e;margin-bottom:9px}
.archpanel .arole .dot{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:3px;border:1px solid}
.archpanel .adoc{color:#2b3138;margin:0 0 11px;font-size:12.5px}
.archpanel .astat{display:flex;gap:14px;margin:0 0 11px;font:11.5px var(--sans);color:var(--grey)}
.archpanel .astat b{display:block;font:600 16px var(--sans);color:var(--navy)}
.archpanel .alist{margin:0 0 9px}
.archpanel .alist .h{font:600 11px var(--sans);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;
                     color:var(--grey);margin-bottom:3px}
.archpanel .alist code{display:inline-block;background:#eef2f6;border-radius:3px;padding:1px 6px;
                       margin:2px 3px 0 0;font-size:11px;cursor:pointer}
.archpanel .alist code:hover{background:var(--navy);color:#fff}
.archpanel .alist .none{color:var(--grey);font-style:italic;font-size:11.5px}
.archpanel .aopen{display:inline-block;margin-top:4px;padding:6px 12px;background:var(--navy);
                  color:#fff;border-radius:5px;font:12px var(--sans);cursor:pointer;border:0}
.archpanel .adirty{display:inline-block;margin-bottom:9px;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:10px;
                   background:#fde3e6;color:var(--red);font:600 11px var(--sans)}
@media(max-width:760px){.archstage{flex-direction:column}
  .archpanel{flex-basis:auto;position:static;max-height:none}}
#archsvg{max-width:none}
#archsvg text{font:11.5px system-ui,sans-serif;fill:#24292f;pointer-events:none}
#archsvg .collab{font:600 9.5px system-ui,sans-serif;fill:var(--grey);text-transform:uppercase;
                 letter-spacing:.07em;transition:opacity .35s}
#archsvg.net .collab{opacity:0}
#archsvg .node{cursor:pointer;transition:transform .6s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)}
#archsvg .node rect{fill:#eef2f6;stroke:#c9d4de;stroke-width:1;transition:fill .35s,stroke .35s}
#archsvg .node.nb rect{fill:#fdf0f2;stroke:#eab8c0}
#archsvg .node:hover rect{stroke:var(--red);stroke-width:2}
#archsvg .deg{fill:var(--grey);font-size:9.5px;text-anchor:end}
#archsvg .edge{fill:none;stroke:#c2ccd6;stroke-width:1.2;transition:stroke .3s}
#archsvg.iso .edge{stroke:#e8edf1}
#archsvg.iso .edge.hot{stroke:var(--red);stroke-width:1.9}
#archsvg.iso .node rect{opacity:.25}
#archsvg.iso .node.hot rect{opacity:1;stroke:var(--navy)}
#archsvg.iso .node text{opacity:.3}
#archsvg.iso .node.hot text{opacity:1}
#archsvg .node.pin rect{stroke:var(--red);stroke-width:2.4}
#archsvg .node.off{display:none}
#archsvg .edge.off{display:none}
/* cluster hulls — only meaningful in the network view, and only when asked for */
#archhulls{opacity:0;transition:opacity .4s;pointer-events:none}
#archsvg.net.hulls #archhulls{opacity:.4}
.hull{stroke-width:1.5;stroke-dasharray:4 4}
/* path tracing: A -> B */
#archsvg.path .node rect{opacity:.18}
#archsvg.path .edge{stroke:#e8edf1}
#archsvg.path .node.onpath rect{opacity:1;stroke:var(--navy);stroke-width:2}
#archsvg.path .node text{opacity:.25}
#archsvg.path .node.onpath text{opacity:1}
#archsvg.path .edge.onpath{stroke:var(--red);stroke-width:2.2}
#archsvg .node.ep rect{stroke:var(--red);stroke-width:2.6}
/* change-impact overlay */
#archsvg.impact .node rect{fill:#f2f4f6;stroke:#d3d9df}
#archsvg.impact .node.dirty rect{fill:#fde3e6;stroke:var(--red);stroke-width:2}
#archsvg.impact .node.impacted rect{fill:#fff3d9;stroke:#d9a227;stroke-width:1.6}
#archsvg.impact .node text{opacity:.55}
#archsvg.impact .node.dirty text,#archsvg.impact .node.impacted text{opacity:1}
/* interactive / static affordance chips */
.ixbadge{display:inline-block;vertical-align:middle;margin-left:8px;padding:2px 9px;border-radius:20px;
         font:600 11px var(--sans);letter-spacing:.02em;background:var(--red);color:#fff;
         text-transform:none;white-space:nowrap;transform:translateY(-1px)}
.ixbadge.hover,.ixbadge.static{background:transparent;color:var(--grey);border:1px solid var(--line);font-weight:500}
h1 .ixbadge,h2 .ixbadge,h3 .ixbadge{font-size:11px}
/* sidebar marker for sheets that are interactive */
#side a .ixdot{display:inline-block;width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--red);
         margin-left:6px;vertical-align:middle}
/* inline citations + APA reference list */
.cite{color:var(--red);border-bottom:1px dotted var(--red);cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;
      white-space:nowrap}
.cite:hover{background:#fbe9ec}
#bibpop{position:absolute;z-index:60;max-width:360px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);
        border-radius:7px;box-shadow:0 8px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.15);padding:11px 13px;
        font:12.5px/1.55 var(--serif);color:#24313b;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;
        transition:opacity .12s;pointer-events:none}
#bibpop.on{opacity:1;visibility:visible}
#bibpop i{font-style:italic}
.reflist{margin:16px 0}
.refitem{padding:10px 12px 10px 34px;text-indent:-22px;font:14px/1.6 var(--serif);color:#222}
.refitem+.refitem{border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.refitem i{font-style:italic}
.refitem.flash{background:#fff6d9}
.refsrc{margin-left:6px;font:11px var(--sans);white-space:nowrap;text-indent:0;display:inline-block}
/* analysis-sample waterfall */
.wfblock+.wfblock{margin-top:30px;border-top:2px solid var(--line);padding-top:6px}
.wf{margin:12px 0 4px}
.wfrow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:210px 1fr;gap:6px 14px;align-items:center;
       padding:7px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.wfrow:first-child{border-top:0}
.wflab{font:600 13px var(--sans);color:var(--navy)}
.wfbar{position:relative;background:var(--soft);border-radius:4px;height:26px;
       display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:0 10px;overflow:hidden;font:12px var(--sans)}
.wfbar span{position:absolute;inset:0 auto 0 0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#cfe0ec,#e7eef4);
            border-right:2px solid var(--navy);z-index:0}
.wfbar b,.wfbar i,.wfbar u{position:relative;z-index:1}
.wfbar b{color:var(--navy);font-weight:700}
.wfbar i{color:var(--grey);font-style:normal}
.wfbar u{margin-left:auto;color:#8a5a2b;text-decoration:none;font-size:11px}
.wfwhy{grid-column:2;font:11.5px var(--sans);color:var(--grey);margin-top:-2px}
.wfwhy em{color:var(--red);font-style:normal;font-weight:600}
.wfnote{margin-top:10px}
.wfh{margin:20px 0 2px;font:600 15px var(--sans);color:var(--navy)}
.wfchips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin:10px 0 14px}
.wfchip{position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;cursor:pointer;
        border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:5px 13px;background:#fff;
        font:12.5px var(--sans);color:#41474e;transition:background .2s,border-color .2s}
.wfchip:has(input:checked){background:var(--navy);border-color:var(--navy);color:#fff}
.wfchip input{accent-color:var(--red);margin:0}
.wfchip .wftip{position:absolute;bottom:calc(100% + 7px);left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);
        background:#24292f;color:#fff;padding:6px 9px;border-radius:5px;font:11px/1.4 var(--sans);
        width:210px;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:opacity .15s;z-index:5;text-align:center}
.wfchip:hover .wftip{opacity:1;visibility:visible}
.wfout{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;padding:0;overflow:hidden}
.wfhead{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:baseline;gap:6px 20px;padding:14px 16px;
        background:linear-gradient(90deg,#f2f6fa,#fbfcfd)}
.wfhead .big{font:700 30px var(--sans);color:var(--navy);line-height:1}
.wfhead .lbl{font:12px var(--sans);color:var(--grey)}
.wfhead .sub{font:13px var(--sans);color:#41474e}
.wfhead .sub b{color:#8a5a2b}
.wfmarg{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font:12px var(--sans)}
.wfmarg th,.wfmarg td{padding:6px 16px;text-align:left;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.wfmarg th{font-weight:600;color:var(--grey);background:#fafbfc}
.wfmarg td.num{text-align:right;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.wfmarg tr.active td:first-child{color:var(--navy);font-weight:600}
.wfmarg .costdrop{color:var(--red)}
.wftbls{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:0}
.wftbls .wfmarg+.wfmarg{border-left:1px solid var(--line)}
.wfshare{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin:12px 0 4px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.wfbtn{border:1px solid var(--navy);background:var(--navy);color:#fff;border-radius:5px;
       padding:7px 13px;font:12.5px var(--sans);cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap}
.wfbtn.sm{padding:4px 10px;font-size:11.5px}
.wfbtn:hover{background:#00294a}
.wflink{flex:1 1 320px;min-width:0;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:5px;padding:7px 10px;
        font:11.5px ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;color:#41474e;background:#fbfcfd}
.wfsnipwrap{margin:10px 0 4px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden}
.wfsniphead{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;
            background:#f2f6fa;padding:7px 12px;font:600 12px var(--sans);color:var(--navy)}
.wfsnip{margin:0;padding:12px 14px;overflow-x:auto;background:#fbfcfd;border:0;border-radius:0}
.wfsnip code{font:12px/1.55 ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;color:#24313b;white-space:pre}
/* rank-reset histogram */
.rrwrap{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;padding:12px 10px 4px;background:#fdfdfe;
        overflow-x:auto;margin:12px 0 4px}
.rrhist{max-width:100%}
.rrhist rect{transition:opacity .15s}.rrhist rect:hover{opacity:.75}
.rrhist .rrx{font:9px var(--sans);fill:var(--grey);text-anchor:middle}
.rrhist .rrn{font:8.5px var(--sans);fill:#6b7580;text-anchor:middle}
.rrhist .rrax{font:10px var(--sans);fill:var(--grey)}
/* rank-reset overlaid areas by theatre */
.rrbar{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:6px 0 8px}
.rrlg{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;cursor:pointer;background:#fff;
      border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:4px 12px;font:12px var(--sans);
      color:#41474e;opacity:1}
.rrlg .sw{width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:3px}
.rrlg i{color:var(--grey);font-style:normal;font-size:11px}
.rrlg.off{opacity:.4}
.rrarea{max-width:100%}
.rrarea .rrx{font:9px var(--sans);fill:var(--grey);text-anchor:middle}
.rrarea .rrax{font:10px var(--sans);fill:var(--grey)}
.rrarea .rra.off,.rrarea .rral.off{display:none}
.rrarea .rral{transition:stroke-width .15s}
/* rank-reset combat-only vs inclusive toggle */
.rrmodebar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:6px 0 6px}
.rrmodebar .h{font:600 12px var(--sans);color:var(--navy)}
.rrmode{border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:5px;padding:5px 12px;
        font:12px var(--sans);color:#41474e;cursor:pointer}
.rrmode.on{background:var(--navy);border-color:var(--navy);color:#fff;font-weight:600}
.rrmodenote{flex:1 1 260px;font:11px var(--sans);color:var(--grey)}
.rrsec.combatonly .rr-all{display:none}
.rrsec:not(.combatonly) .rr-combat{display:none}
/* waterfall live theatre bar */
.wfcomp{margin:6px 16px 14px}
.wfcomp .h{font:11px var(--sans);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;color:var(--grey);
           margin-bottom:5px}
.wfcompbar{display:flex;height:30px;border-radius:5px;overflow:hidden;background:#eef1f4;
           box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line)}
.wfcompbar .seg{height:100%;transition:width .45s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);min-width:0;
                position:relative}
.wfcompbar .seg span{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
                     color:#fff;font:11px var(--sans);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden}
.wfcomplab{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px 12px;margin-top:6px;font:11px var(--sans);color:#41474e}
.wfcomplab span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px}
.wfcomplab .sw{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:2px}
.wfcompghost{margin-top:5px;font:11px var(--sans);color:var(--grey)}
@media(max-width:640px){.wfrow{grid-template-columns:1fr}.wfwhy{grid-column:1}
  .wftbls{grid-template-columns:1fr}.wftbls .wfmarg+.wfmarg{border-left:0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}}
/* provenance bipartite */
.pvbar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:6px 0 10px}
.pvlg{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;cursor:pointer;background:#fff;
      border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:3px 11px 3px 7px;
      font:11.5px var(--sans);color:#41474e;opacity:.5}
.pvlg.on{opacity:1}
.pvlg .sw{width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:3px;border:1px solid}
.pvhint{font:12px var(--sans);color:var(--grey);margin-left:6px;flex:1 1 220px}
.pvwrap{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;padding:10px;overflow:auto;background:#fdfdfe}
#pvsvg{max-width:none}
#pvsvg text{font:12px var(--sans);fill:#24292f;pointer-events:none}
#pvsvg .pvcol{font:600 10px var(--sans);fill:var(--grey);letter-spacing:.08em}
#pvsvg .pvnode{cursor:pointer}
#pvsvg .pvnode rect{transition:opacity .25s,stroke-width .2s;stroke-width:1.2}
#pvsvg .pvnode:hover rect{stroke-width:2.4}
#pvsvg .pvedge{fill:none;stroke:#c7d0d9;stroke-width:1.3;opacity:.55;transition:opacity .25s,stroke-width .2s}
/* category dimming (legend filter) */
#pvsvg .pvnode.catoff{display:none}
#pvsvg .pvedge.catoff{display:none}
/* selection isolate */
#pvsvg.sel .pvnode rect{opacity:.22}
#pvsvg.sel .pvnode.hot rect{opacity:1}
#pvsvg.sel .pvnode.pin rect{stroke-width:2.6}
#pvsvg.sel .pvnode text{opacity:.3}
#pvsvg.sel .pvnode.hot text{opacity:1}
#pvsvg.sel .pvedge{opacity:.06}
#pvsvg.sel .pvedge.hot{opacity:.95;stroke-width:2.1;stroke:var(--navy)}
/* provenance side panel */
.pvlayout{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start}
.pvlayout .pvwrap{flex:1 1 auto;min-width:0;margin:0}
.pvpanel{flex:0 0 262px;align-self:stretch;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;
         background:#fff;font:12.5px/1.55 var(--sans);position:sticky;top:10px;overflow:hidden}
.pvpanel.empty{background:#fbfcfd}
.pvpanel .ph{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:10px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.pvpanel .ph .sw{width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:3px;border:1px solid;flex:none}
.pvpanel .ph .ttl{font-weight:600;color:#24292f;line-height:1.25}
.pvpanel .pclose{margin-left:auto;cursor:pointer;border:0;background:none;font-size:18px;
                 color:var(--grey);line-height:1;padding:0 2px}
.pvpanel .pclose:hover{color:var(--navy)}
.pvpanel .pbody{padding:10px 12px}
.pvpanel .prole{display:block;font:600 10px var(--sans);letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;
                color:var(--grey);margin-bottom:6px}
.pvpanel .pnote{color:#41474e;margin:0}
.pvpanel .pnoteh{font:600 10px var(--sans);color:var(--grey);letter-spacing:.05em;
                 text-transform:uppercase;margin:0 0 3px}
.pvpanel .plinks h4{font:600 10px var(--sans);color:var(--grey);letter-spacing:.05em;
                    text-transform:uppercase;margin:12px 0 4px}
.pvpanel .plinks a{display:block;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:4px;color:var(--navy);
                   text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer}
.pvpanel .plinks a:hover{background:#eef2f6}
.pvpanel .pvrefblk a{font:400 11.5px/1.45 var(--sans);color:#41474e;padding:4px 8px}
.pvpanel .pvrefblk a:hover{background:#eef2f6;color:var(--navy)}
.pvpanel .pvrefblk i{font-style:italic}
/* regiment explorer (Habsburg-army sheet) */
.regxbar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin:10px 0}
.regxlbl{font:600 10px var(--sans);letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;
         color:var(--grey);margin-left:8px}
.regxchip{cursor:pointer;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;
          padding:3px 11px;font:11.5px var(--sans);color:#41474e;opacity:.6}
.regxchip.on{opacity:1;border-color:var(--navy);color:var(--navy);font-weight:600}
.regxq{margin-left:auto;padding:5px 10px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:5px;
       font:12.5px system-ui,sans-serif}
.regxcount{flex-basis:100%;font:12px var(--sans);color:var(--grey);margin-top:2px}
.regxtbl th{cursor:pointer;user-select:none;white-space:nowrap}
.regxtbl th:hover{color:var(--navy)}
.regxtbl td{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
@media(max-width:820px){.pvlayout{flex-direction:column}
  .pvpanel{flex-basis:auto;width:100%;position:static}}
.mathblock{overflow-x:auto;overflow-y:hidden;margin:14px 0;text-align:center;max-width:100%}
math{font-size:1.04em;max-width:100%}
math[display="block"]{overflow-x:auto;overflow-y:hidden}
/* KaTeX fallback only: its hidden MathML + stretchy SVG can escape an inline box */
.katex-mathml{display:none}
.katex{max-width:100%}
#search{width:calc(100% - 40px);margin:0 20px 8px;padding:8px 11px;border:1px solid var(--line);
        border-radius:5px;font:13px system-ui,sans-serif}
#results{margin:0 12px;font:12.5px/1.5 system-ui,sans-serif}
#results a{display:block;padding:6px 8px;color:#2b3138;text-decoration:none;border-radius:4px}
#results a:hover{background:#eceff3}
#results .hit{color:var(--grey);display:block;font-size:11.5px}
#results mark{background:#ffe8a3;padding:0 1px}
/* ── Link rule ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   ONE rule, stated once: a link in *prose* is navy with a soft underline that firms up
   on hover; a link that is *chrome* (navigation, chips, filters, panels) never underlines
   — its affordance is its shape. Everything in the exemption list below is chrome.
   Outbound links carry a ↗ so leaving the page is never a surprise. No :visited style:
   in a 55-sheet single-page document nearly every internal link is visited within minutes,
   so it would read as noise rather than information. */
a{color:var(--navy)}
main a{text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-thickness:1px;text-underline-offset:2px;
       text-decoration-color:rgba(0,54,87,.35)}
main a:hover{text-decoration-color:var(--navy);text-decoration-thickness:1.5px}
main a[href^="http"]::after{content:"\2197";font-size:.78em;vertical-align:.28em;
       margin-left:1px;opacity:.65;text-decoration:none}
/* chrome exemptions — the complete list, in one place */
#side a,.toc a,.chip,.cite,#results a,.pvpanel .plinks a,.wfbar u,.wflink,.regxchip,
.seealso a,.wayfind a,#pathmap a,.fn summary a{text-decoration:none}
#side a::after,.toc a::after,.chip::after,.cite::after,#results a::after,
.seealso a::after,.wayfind a::after,#pathmap a::after{content:none}
{{ pygments_css }}
.printbtn{display:block;width:calc(100% - 40px);margin:14px 20px 0;padding:8px 10px;
          background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;
          font:13px var(--sans);color:var(--navy)}
.printbtn:hover{background:#eceff3;border-color:var(--navy)}
.fresh{margin:0 0 20px;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:6px;font:13px/1.55 var(--sans)}
.fresh.warn{background:#fff8e6;border:1px solid #e5c76b;color:#6b5000}
.fresh.bad{background:#fdeaec;border:1px solid #e3a2ab;color:#8c1d2b}
.fresh div+div{margin-top:5px}
.fresh code{background:rgba(0,0,0,.06);padding:1px 5px;border-radius:3px}
/* ── shared skeleton: group chip · wayfinder · see-also · figure numbers ────────── */
.grpchip{display:inline-block;vertical-align:middle;margin-left:12px;padding:2px 9px;
  border-radius:10px;font:600 9.5px var(--sans);letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:#fff;position:relative;top:-3px}
#side .grp .gdot,#side summary.grp .gdot{display:inline-block;width:7px;height:7px;
  border-radius:2px;margin-right:6px;vertical-align:1px}
.wayfind{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:var(--sp1) var(--sp2);align-items:baseline;
  margin:0 0 var(--sp4);padding:var(--sp2) var(--sp3);background:var(--soft);
  border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r2);font:12.5px/1.6 var(--sans)}
.wayfind .wfl{font:700 9.5px var(--sans);letter-spacing:.11em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--grey);margin-right:var(--sp1)}
.wayfind a,.wayfind .here{padding:2px 9px;border-radius:11px;border:1px solid var(--line);
  background:#fff;color:var(--navy)}
.wayfind a:hover{border-color:var(--navy)}
.wayfind .here{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;border-color:var(--navy);font-weight:600}
.wayfind i{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--grey)}
.wayfind .here i{color:#bfd0dd}
.seealso{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(215px,1fr));
  gap:var(--sp2);margin:var(--sp5) 0 0;padding-top:var(--sp3);border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.seealso .sal{grid-column:1/-1;font:700 9.5px var(--sans);letter-spacing:.11em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--grey)}
.seealso a{display:block;padding:9px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:var(--r2);background:#fff;color:var(--navy)}
.seealso a:hover{border-color:var(--navy);background:var(--soft)}
.seealso b{display:block;font-size:13.5px}
.seealso span{display:block;font:11.5px/1.45 var(--sans);color:var(--grey);margin-top:2px}
.figno{color:var(--navy);font-weight:700}
/* ── the 1910 register: a page of the source, annotated ─────────────────────────── */
.lxbar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:var(--sp2);align-items:center;margin:0 0 var(--sp3)}
.lxtab{font:12.5px var(--sans);padding:5px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:99px;background:#fff;color:#41474d;cursor:pointer}
.lxtab.on{background:var(--navy);border-color:var(--navy);color:#fff}
.lxtoggle{font:12px var(--sans);color:var(--grey);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;
  gap:5px;margin-left:auto;cursor:pointer}
.lxlayout{display:flex;gap:var(--sp4);align-items:flex-start;margin:0 0 var(--sp4)}
.lxwrap{flex:1 1 auto;min-width:0}
.lxstage{display:none}
.lxstage.on{display:block}
/* both pages print, because the tab is a screen affordance and paper has no tabs */
@media print{.lxstage{display:block;break-inside:avoid}.lxtab,.lxtoggle{display:none}}
.lxcap{font:11.5px var(--sans);color:var(--grey);margin:0 0 6px}
.lxcap b{color:var(--navy);font-weight:600}
.lxframe{position:relative;line-height:0;border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:var(--r1);overflow:hidden;background:#fff}
.lxframe img{width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
.lxsvg{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%}
.lxz{fill:rgba(0,54,87,.05);stroke:#5f89a8;stroke-width:1.4;cursor:pointer;
  transition:fill .12s}
.lxz:hover{fill:rgba(0,54,87,.16)}
.lxz.focus{stroke:var(--red);fill:rgba(210,45,64,.07)}
.lxz.bad{stroke:var(--red);stroke-dasharray:5 3;fill:rgba(210,45,64,.05)}
.lxz.sel{fill:rgba(0,54,87,.24);stroke-width:2.6}
.lxz.focus.sel{fill:rgba(210,45,64,.22)}
.lxhide .lxz{fill:none;stroke:none;pointer-events:none}
.lxpanel{flex:0 0 320px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r2);
  background:var(--soft);padding:var(--sp3);font:13px/1.6 var(--sans);
  position:sticky;top:16px;max-height:82vh;overflow:auto}
.lxpanel.empty{background:#fff;border-style:dashed}
.lxpanel .pnote{margin:0;color:var(--grey);font-style:italic}
.lxpanel .phead b{color:var(--navy);font-size:14px}
.lxpanel h4{font:700 9.5px var(--sans);letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--grey);margin:12px 0 5px}
.lxpanel p{margin:0 0 8px}
.lxpre{font:12px/1.5 "SF Mono",Consolas,monospace;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:var(--r1);padding:7px 9px;margin:0 0 8px;white-space:pre-wrap;
  overflow-x:auto;color:#41474d}
.lxcrop{width:100%;height:auto;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r1);
  display:block;margin:0 0 8px;background:#fff}
.lxpanel .lxcrop{cursor:zoom-in}
.lxsrc{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--grey);margin:0 0 8px}
/* the printed line, the text layer's version of it, and the truth */
.lxrows{display:grid;gap:var(--sp2);margin:0 0 var(--sp4)}
.lxrow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:170px 1fr;gap:var(--sp3);align-items:start;
  border-left:3px solid var(--line);padding:var(--sp2) 0 var(--sp2) var(--sp3)}
.lxrow:last-child{border-left-color:var(--navy)}
.lxk{font:700 9.5px var(--sans);letter-spacing:.09em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--grey);padding-top:3px}
.lxv{min-width:0}
/* never upscale a crop: these are photographs of six-point type, and stretching the
   short German entry to the width of the Czech one turns it to mush */
.lxv .lxcrop{width:auto;max-width:100%;cursor:zoom-in}
.lxv .lxpre,.lxv .lxcrop{margin-bottom:5px}
.lxglyphs{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:var(--sp2) var(--sp3);align-items:flex-end;
  font:15px var(--serif);margin:0 0 6px}
.lxg{display:inline-flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:2px}
.lxg img{height:26px;width:auto;display:block}
.lxg i{font:italic 10.5px var(--serif);color:var(--grey);max-width:130px;text-align:center;
  line-height:1.25}
/* the block, as the parser read it */
.lxtbl{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font:11.5px var(--sans);margin:0 0 8px}
.lxtbl th{font:700 9px var(--sans);letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--grey);text-align:right;padding:2px 4px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.lxtbl th:nth-child(2){text-align:left}
.lxtbl td{padding:2px 4px;text-align:right;border-bottom:1px solid #e7eaee;
  font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.lxtbl td:nth-child(2){text-align:left}
.lxtbl tr.muni td{font-weight:700;color:var(--navy)}
.lxtbl td.bad{background:#fdeaec;color:#a3172a;font-weight:700}
/* the walkthrough past the frozen run: text cells, so left-aligned */
.lxwalk th,.lxwalk td,.lxwalk th:nth-child(2),.lxwalk td:nth-child(2){text-align:left}
.lxwalk td{vertical-align:top}
.lxwalk2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:var(--sp3)}
@media (max-width:700px){.lxwalk2{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
/* the two plates, and the vocabulary cut out of them */
.lxplates{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:var(--sp4);margin:0 0 var(--sp4)}
.lxplates figure{margin:0}
.lxplate{width:100%;height:auto;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r1);
  cursor:zoom-in;background:#fff}
.lxgal{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(150px,1fr));
  gap:var(--sp2);margin:0 0 var(--sp4)}
.lxgc{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r1);padding:7px 8px;background:#fff;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;align-items:flex-start}
.lxgc img{height:24px;width:auto}
.lxgc b{font:600 11.5px var(--sans);color:#24292f;line-height:1.3}
.lxgc code{font:10px "SF Mono",Consolas,monospace;color:var(--grey)}
@media(max-width:1100px){
  .lxlayout{display:block}
  .lxpanel{position:static;max-height:none;margin-top:var(--sp3)}
  .lxplates{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .lxrow{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:var(--sp1)}
}

/* ── the 1910 register's reading route ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
.rtctl{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;align-items:center;margin:0 0 var(--sp3)}
.rtctll{font:700 9.5px var(--sans);letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--grey);margin:0 2px 0 10px}
.rtctll:first-child{margin-left:0}
.rtpill,.rtset{font:12.5px var(--sans);color:#24292f;background:#fff;cursor:pointer;
  border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:4px 13px;display:inline-flex;
  align-items:baseline;gap:6px}
.rtpill i,.rtset i{font:italic 11px var(--serif);color:var(--grey)}
.rtpill:hover,.rtset:hover{border-color:#9aa3ad}
.rtpill.on,.rtset.on{background:var(--navy);border-color:var(--navy);color:#fff}
.rtpill.on i,.rtset.on i{color:#cdd9e2}
.rtpill:disabled{cursor:not-allowed;opacity:.45}
.rtset i.read{color:#6c7f1f}.rtset i.next{color:var(--red)}
.rtset.on i.read,.rtset.on i.next{color:#cdd9e2}
.rtlayout{display:flex;gap:var(--sp4);align-items:flex-start;margin:0 0 var(--sp3)}
.rtwrap{flex:1 1 auto;overflow-x:auto}
#rtsvg{max-width:100%;height:auto;font-family:var(--sans)}
#rtsvg .rthead{font:700 10.5px var(--sans);letter-spacing:.09em;fill:var(--navy)}
#rtsvg .rtsub{font:italic 11.5px var(--serif);fill:var(--grey)}
#rtsvg .rtstage{cursor:pointer}
#rtsvg .rtstage .rtbox{transition:filter .12s}
#rtsvg .rtstage:hover .rtbox{filter:brightness(.96)}
#rtsvg .rtstage.sel .rtbox{stroke-width:2.5px}
#rtsvg .rtnt{font:700 11.5px var(--sans);fill:#fff;text-anchor:middle}
#rtsvg .rtlab{font:600 13px var(--sans);fill:#1a1d21}
#rtsvg .rtgloss{font:italic 11.5px var(--serif);fill:#41474d}
#rtsvg .rtwho rect{fill:#fff;stroke:#b4bcc2;stroke-width:1}
#rtsvg .rtwho text{font:600 9.5px var(--sans);fill:#41474d;text-anchor:middle}
#rtsvg .rtarrow{stroke:#b4bcc2;stroke-width:1.2;fill:none}
/* the exits: a mark's four ways off the spine, each colour used here and in the bar below */
#rtsvg .rtelbow{fill:none;stroke-width:1.3;opacity:.55;stroke-dasharray:4 3}
#rtsvg .rtelbow.lit{opacity:1;stroke-dasharray:none;stroke-width:2}
#rtsvg .rtexit rect{transition:filter .12s}
#rtsvg .rtexit.lit rect{stroke-width:2.2px;filter:brightness(.98)}
#rtsvg .rtelab{font:600 12px var(--sans);fill:#1a1d21}
#rtsvg .rtegloss{font:italic 10.5px var(--serif);fill:var(--grey)}
#rtsvg .rten{font:700 15px var(--sans);fill:var(--navy);text-anchor:end;
  font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
#rtsvg .rtesh{font:10.5px var(--sans);fill:var(--grey);text-anchor:end}
.rtpanel{flex:0 0 300px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r2);
  background:var(--soft);padding:var(--sp3);font:13px/1.6 var(--sans);position:sticky;top:16px;
  max-height:78vh;overflow:auto}
.rtpanel.empty{background:#fff;border-style:dashed}
.rtpanel .pnote{margin:0;color:var(--grey);font-style:italic}
.rtpanel .phead{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:var(--sp2)}
.rtpanel .phead b{color:var(--navy);font-size:14.5px}
.rtpanel .rtkind{font:600 10px "SF Mono",Consolas,monospace;padding:1px 7px;border-radius:9px;
  background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);color:#41474d}
.rtpanel .pmeta{margin:2px 0 10px;color:var(--grey);font-size:11.5px;font-style:italic}
.rtpanel h4{font:700 9.5px var(--sans);letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--grey);margin:12px 0 5px}
.rtpanel p{margin:0 0 6px}
.rtpanel .rtoff{font-size:12px;margin:0 0 8px;padding:6px 9px;border-radius:var(--r1);
  background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);color:#41474d}
.rtpanel .psym{margin:12px 0 0;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--grey)}
.rtpanel .rtfacts{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font:11.5px var(--sans)}
.rtpanel .rtfacts td{padding:3px 0;vertical-align:top;border-bottom:1px solid #e7eaee}
.rtpanel .rtfacts tr:last-child td{border-bottom:0}
.rtpanel .rtfacts td:first-child{color:var(--grey);padding-right:8px;width:44%}
.rtpanel .rtfacts td:last-child{color:#24292f}
.rtpanel .rtfacts i{color:var(--grey);font-size:11px}
.rtpanel .rtnone{color:var(--grey);font-size:11.5px;font-style:italic}
/* how every mark of the run was settled, as one band */
/* amateur-theatre sheet: trend, map, records explainer */
.thbar,.thctl{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:6px 8px;margin:8px 0 6px;
  font:12px var(--sans);color:var(--ink-soft)}
.thbtn{font:12px var(--sans);border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;color:var(--ink);
  border-radius:999px;padding:4px 11px;cursor:pointer}
.thbtn.on{background:var(--navy);border-color:var(--navy);color:#fff}
.thwrap{position:relative;max-width:820px;margin:4px 0 22px}
.thwrap svg{display:block;width:100%;height:auto}
.thtip{position:absolute;z-index:20;display:none;pointer-events:none;max-width:300px;
  background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;padding:6px 9px;
  font:12px/1.45 var(--sans);color:var(--ink);box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.09)}
.thtip.on{display:block}
.thmut{color:var(--grey);font-size:11px}
.thax{font:10px var(--sans);fill:var(--grey)}
.thgrid{stroke:#eef1f4}
.thbase{stroke:#c9d4de}
.thms{stroke:#6E6E6E;stroke-dasharray:3 3}
.thmslab{font:10px var(--sans);fill:#6E6E6E}
.thband{fill:#003657;fill-opacity:.2;stroke:none}
.thcert{fill:none;stroke:#003657;stroke-width:1.6}
.thposs{fill:none;stroke:#003657;stroke-width:1;stroke-dasharray:4 3}
.thcur{stroke:#D22D40;visibility:hidden}.thcur.on{visibility:visible}
.thmap{max-width:760px}
.thmap path.thc{stroke:none;cursor:pointer;transition:fill .12s}
.thmap path.thc:hover{stroke:#D22D40;stroke-width:1.4}
#thokres{fill:none;stroke:#fff;stroke-width:.8;pointer-events:none}
#thyear{width:min(320px,60vw)}
.thyear{font:600 17px var(--sans);color:var(--navy);min-width:2.6em}
.thscale{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;margin-left:6px}
.thscale i{font-style:normal;color:var(--grey);font-size:11px}
.thramp{display:inline-block;width:90px;height:9px;border-radius:2px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgb(240,243,246),rgb(0,54,87))}
.thsel{font:13px var(--sans);padding:3px 6px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:4px;max-width:100%}
.thkey{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;font-size:11px}
.thkey .sw{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:2px}
.thlane{font:11px var(--sans);fill:var(--ink)}.thlane.b{font-weight:600}
.thxp{fill-opacity:.22}.thxc{fill-opacity:1}
.rtbar{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r2);background:var(--soft);
  padding:var(--sp3);margin:0 0 var(--sp4)}
.rtbarhd{font:13px var(--sans);color:#24292f;margin:0 0 7px}
.rtbarhd b{color:var(--navy);font-size:16px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.rtmix{display:flex;height:13px;border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden;background:#e7eaee}
.rtmix span{height:100%}
.rtmixlab{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px 14px;font:11.5px var(--sans);color:#41474e;
  margin:7px 0 0}
.rtmixlab span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px}
.rtmixlab i{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:2px}
.rtmixlab b{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--navy)}
.rtnote{margin:8px 0 0;font:12px/1.6 var(--sans);color:var(--grey)}
.rtnote b{color:var(--red)}
@media(max-width:1100px){
  .rtlayout{display:block}
  .rtpanel{position:static;max-height:none;margin-top:var(--sp3)}
}

/* ── place-matching flow ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.pfbar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:var(--sp2);align-items:center;margin:0 0 var(--sp3)}
.pflgs{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:var(--sp1) var(--sp3);font:11.5px var(--sans);
  color:var(--grey)}
.pflg{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px}
.pflg .sw{width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:3px;border:1px solid}
.pflg i{color:#9aa3ad}
.pflayout{display:flex;gap:var(--sp4);align-items:flex-start;margin:0 0 var(--sp4)}
.pfwrap{flex:1 1 auto;overflow-x:auto}
#pfsvg{max-width:100%;height:auto;font-family:var(--sans)}
#pfsvg .pfhead{font:700 10.5px var(--sans);letter-spacing:.09em;fill:var(--navy)}
#pfsvg .pfsub{font:italic 11.5px var(--serif);fill:var(--grey)}
#pfsvg .pfstage{cursor:pointer}
#pfsvg .pfstage .pfbox{transition:filter .12s}
#pfsvg .pfstage:hover .pfbox{filter:brightness(.96)}
#pfsvg .pfstage.sel .pfbox{stroke-width:2.5px}
#pfsvg .pfstage.layer .pfbox{stroke-dasharray:5 3}
/* the residual ribbon: what is still unplaced as the lane runs down */
#pfsvg .pfrib{fill:#dfe5ea;stroke:#c3ccd4;stroke-width:.8;transition:d .5s ease}
#pfsvg .pfribcap{font:600 9.5px var(--sans);fill:#7d868f;letter-spacing:.04em}
#pfsvg .pfslab.hand{fill:#5f89a8;font-style:normal;font-weight:600;font-size:9.5px}
/* per-stage magnitude bar: the tier against the largest in its lane */
#pfsvg .pfbart{fill:#000;opacity:.07}
#pfsvg .pfbarv{transition:width .5s ease}
/* keep/drop tick */
#pfsvg .pfkeepbox rect{fill:#fff;stroke:#8a939c;stroke-width:1.2}
#pfsvg .pfkeepbox{cursor:pointer}
#pfsvg .pftick{fill:none;stroke:var(--navy);stroke-width:2.2;stroke-linecap:round;
  stroke-linejoin:round}
#pfsvg .pfstage.drop .pftick{display:none}
#pfsvg .pfstage.drop .pfbox{opacity:.32}
#pfsvg .pfstage.drop .pflab,#pfsvg .pfstage.drop .pfstat,#pfsvg .pfstage.drop .pftier,
#pfsvg .pfstage.drop .pfslab{opacity:.42}
#pfsvg .pfstage.drop .pfbarv{opacity:.3}
#pfsvg .pflab{font:600 12.5px var(--sans);fill:#1a1d21}
#pfsvg .pfstat{font:11.5px var(--sans);fill:#41474d}
#pfsvg .pftier{font:600 10px "SF Mono",Consolas,monospace;fill:#41474d;text-anchor:end}
#pfsvg .pfslab{font:italic 10.5px var(--serif);fill:var(--grey);text-anchor:end}
#pfsvg .pfarrow{stroke:#b4bcc2;stroke-width:1.2;fill:none}
#pfsvg .pfvl{stroke:#e3a2ab;stroke-width:1.2;stroke-dasharray:3 2;fill:none}
#pfsvg .pfveto circle{fill:#fdeaec;stroke:#d0687a;stroke-width:1.2}
#pfsvg .pfveto text{font:11px var(--sans);fill:#a3172a;text-anchor:middle}
.pfpanel{flex:0 0 288px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r2);
  background:var(--soft);padding:var(--sp3);font:13px/1.6 var(--sans);position:sticky;top:16px}
.pfpanel.empty{background:#fff;border-style:dashed}
.pfpanel .pnote{margin:0;color:var(--grey);font-style:italic}
.pfpanel .phead{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:var(--sp2)}
.pfpanel .phead b{color:var(--navy);font-size:14px}
.pfpanel .ptier{font:600 10px "SF Mono",Consolas,monospace;padding:1px 7px;border-radius:9px;
  background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);color:#41474d}
.pfpanel .pmeta{margin:2px 0 10px;color:var(--grey);font-size:11.5px}
.pfpanel h4{font:700 9.5px var(--sans);letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--grey);margin:12px 0 5px}
.pfpanel ul{margin:0;padding-left:17px}
.pfpanel li{margin:0 0 5px}
.pfpanel .psym{margin:12px 0 0;font-size:11.5px}
/* what the tier actually matched — recorded string → resolved district */
.pfpanel .pfex{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font:11.5px var(--sans);margin:2px 0 0}
.pfpanel .pfex td{padding:2px 0;vertical-align:top;border-bottom:1px solid #e7eaee}
.pfpanel .pfex tr:last-child td{border-bottom:0}
.pfpanel .pfex .a{color:#24292f}
.pfpanel .pfex .b{color:var(--navy);padding-left:6px}
.pfpanel .pfex .n{text-align:right;color:var(--grey);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;
  padding-left:8px;white-space:nowrap}
/* click-a-district: the map read backwards, from the place to the men */
.pfpanel .pfstatline{margin:2px 0 6px;font-size:13px}
.pfpanel .pfstatline b{font-size:19px;color:var(--navy);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.pfpanel .pfstatline span{color:var(--grey);font-size:11.5px}
.pfpanel .pfstatline i{color:var(--grey);font-size:11.5px;margin-left:5px}
.pfpanel .pfsmall{margin:2px 0;color:var(--grey);font-size:12px}
.pfpanel .pfrate{position:relative;height:7px;border-radius:4px;background:#e7eaee;
  overflow:visible;margin:0 0 4px}
.pfpanel .pfrate span{display:block;height:100%;border-radius:4px;background:var(--navy)}
.pfpanel .pfrate i{position:absolute;top:-3px;width:1px;height:13px;background:var(--red)}
.pfpanel .pfmix{display:flex;height:9px;border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden;margin:2px 0 5px}
.pfpanel .pfmix span{height:100%}
.pfpanel .pfmixlab{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:3px 10px;font-size:11px;color:#41474e}
.pfpanel .pfmixlab span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px}
.pfpanel .pfmixlab i{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:2px}
/* keep/drop readout — the figure's answer to "drop the weak tiers and see what moves" */
.pfkeep{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r2);background:var(--soft);
  padding:var(--sp3);margin:0 0 var(--sp4)}
.pfkeepn{font:13.5px/1.6 var(--sans);color:#24292f}
.pfkeepn b{color:var(--navy);font-size:16px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.pfkeepn .warn{color:var(--red)}
.pfkeepact{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:9px 0 0}
.pfmask{margin:9px 0 0;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:5px;
  padding:9px 11px;overflow-x:auto;font:11.5px/1.65 "SF Mono",Consolas,monospace;color:#24292f}
/* the map: one plane, both frames */
.pfmapwrap{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r2);background:#fdfdfe;
  padding:10px 12px 8px;margin:0 0 var(--sp4)}
.pfmaphd{font:12.5px var(--sans);color:#41474e;margin:0 0 6px;min-height:19px}
.pfmaphd b{color:var(--navy)}
#pfmap{width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
/* The polygons carry fill only; all three border classes are their own layer on top. The
   old build stroked every polygon and then over-printed the court lines in pale grey — light
   strokes on dark fills, which read as scratches rather than as a weaker class of line. */
#pfmap .pfd{stroke:none;fill:#f1f3f5;transition:fill .35s ease;cursor:pointer}
#pfcourtlines,#pftwinlines,#pfokreslines{fill:none;pointer-events:none;
  stroke-linejoin:round;stroke-linecap:round;vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke}
#pfokreslines{stroke:#4a5b68;stroke-width:1}
#pftwinlines{stroke:#4a5b68;stroke-width:1}
#pfcourtlines{stroke:#b9c3cb;stroke-width:.6;display:none}
/* drawn at soudní okres: the sub-divisions come in, still visibly the weaker line */
#pfmap.courtmode #pfcourtlines{display:inline}
/* pooled: the city/ring border is not a boundary of the census unit, so it comes off —
   and in court mode it drops to the hairline class it belongs to there */
#pfmap.pooled #pftwinlines{display:none}
#pfmap.courtmode.pooled #pftwinlines{display:inline;stroke:#b9c3cb;stroke-width:.6}
/* Hover and selection outline the unit you are actually pointing at. Drawn at political
   okres that is the okres, so the outline comes off its own layer — stroking the member
   polygons would ring every court division inside it and draw the district as a bundle of
   shapes rather than as one. Drawn at soudní okres the polygon IS the unit, so it strokes
   itself and the outline layers stand down. */
#pfhoverline,#pfselline{fill:none;pointer-events:none;stroke-linejoin:round;
  stroke-linecap:round;vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke}
#pfhoverline{stroke:var(--red);stroke-width:1.4;opacity:.6}
#pfselline{stroke:var(--red);stroke-width:2}
#pfmap .pfd:hover,#pfmap .pfd.sel{stroke:none}
#pfmap.courtmode #pfhoverline,#pfmap.courtmode #pfselline{display:none}
#pfmap.courtmode .pfd:hover{stroke:var(--red);stroke-width:1.4}
#pfmap.courtmode .pfd.sel{stroke:var(--red);stroke-width:2}
.pfunitbar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:0 0 8px}
.pfunitlab{font:600 10px var(--sans);letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--grey)}
.pfunit{border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:5px;padding:4px 11px;
  font:12px var(--sans);color:#41474e;cursor:pointer}
.pfunit.on{background:var(--navy);border-color:var(--navy);color:#fff;font-weight:600}
.pfunitlab.pfsep{margin-left:10px;padding-left:12px;border-left:1px solid var(--line)}
.pfunitnote{flex:1 1 240px;font:11px var(--sans);color:var(--grey)}
/* the map and its read-out, side by side — the panel used to live beside the funnel, half a
   page up, so a district click landed off screen */
.pfmaplayout{display:flex;gap:var(--sp4);align-items:flex-start;margin:0 0 var(--sp4)}
.pfmaplayout .pfmapwrap{flex:1 1 auto;min-width:0;margin:0}
.pfmaplayout .pfpanel{flex:0 0 262px}
@media(max-width:1100px){.pfmaplayout{flex-direction:column}
  .pfmaplayout .pfpanel{flex:1 1 auto;width:100%;position:static}}
.pfmapleg{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px 10px;margin:8px 0 0;font:11px var(--sans);
  color:var(--grey);flex-wrap:wrap}
.pfmapleg .bin,.pfmapleg .pfmzero{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;
  font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.pfmapleg i{width:20px;height:10px;border-radius:2px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.07)}
.pfmapleg .pfmzero{color:#9aa3ad}
.pfmapleg .pfmnote{font-style:italic}
/* the standing caveat under the map: shown in BOTH units, because the reader who tries to
   add the courts up is usually looking at the okresy when the thought occurs */
.pfsumnote{margin:9px 0 0;padding:8px 11px;background:#fdf7f8;border:1px solid #f0d8dc;
  border-left:3px solid var(--red);border-radius:0 5px 5px 0;
  font:11.5px/1.6 var(--sans);color:#41474e}
.pfsumnote b{color:var(--navy)}
@media(max-width:1100px){.pflayout{flex-direction:column}.pfpanel{flex:1 1 auto;width:100%;
  position:static}}
/* ── occupation funnel: the coding rules, the HISCLASS ladder, the live gradient ──── */
#ocsvg{max-width:100%;height:auto;font-family:var(--sans)}
#ocsvg .ochead{font:700 10.5px var(--sans);letter-spacing:.09em;fill:var(--navy)}
#ocsvg .ocsub{font:italic 11.5px var(--serif);fill:var(--grey)}
#ocsvg .ocrib{fill:#e7eaee;stroke:none;opacity:.85}
#ocsvg .ocribcap{font:600 10px var(--sans);fill:var(--grey)}
#ocsvg .ocarrow{stroke:#b4bcc2;stroke-width:1.2;fill:none}
#ocsvg .ocstage,#ocsvg .occls{cursor:pointer}
#ocsvg .ocbox{transition:filter .12s}
#ocsvg .ocstage:hover .ocbox{filter:brightness(.96)}
#ocsvg .ocstage.sel .ocbox{stroke-width:2.5px}
#ocsvg .oclab{font:600 13px var(--sans);fill:#1d2429}
#ocsvg .ocstat{font:11.5px var(--sans);fill:#41474e;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
#ocsvg .octier{font:600 10px "SF Mono",Consolas,monospace;fill:var(--grey);text-anchor:end}
#ocsvg .ocslab{font:italic 11px var(--serif);fill:#9aa3ad;text-anchor:end}
#ocsvg .ocbart{fill:#fff;opacity:.7}
