#ocsvg .ockeepbox rect{fill:#fff;stroke:#8a939c;stroke-width:1.2}
#ocsvg .octick{fill:none;stroke:var(--navy);stroke-width:2.2;stroke-linecap:round;
  stroke-linejoin:round}
#ocsvg .ocstage[data-keep="0"] .octick{display:none}
#ocsvg .ocstage.drop .ocbox{opacity:.32}
#ocsvg .ocstage.drop .oclab,#ocsvg .ocstage.drop .ocstat{opacity:.45}
#ocsvg .ocveto circle{fill:#fff;stroke:#c98b95;stroke-width:1.2}
#ocsvg .ocveto text{font:12px var(--sans);fill:#b4576b;text-anchor:middle}
#ocsvg .ocvl{stroke:#e2ccd1;stroke-width:1.2}
#ocsvg .ocrowhit{fill:transparent}
#ocsvg .occls:hover .ocrowhit{fill:#f1f3f5}
#ocsvg .occls.sel .ocrowhit{fill:#e9edf1}
#ocsvg .ocno{font:600 10.5px "SF Mono",Consolas,monospace;fill:var(--grey);text-anchor:start}
#ocsvg .ocrung{stroke-width:1}
#ocsvg .ocrung.dash{fill:#f4f5f7;stroke:#b4bcc2;stroke-dasharray:4 3}
#ocsvg .occnt{font:11.5px var(--sans);fill:#41474e;text-anchor:end;
  font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.oclg{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px}
.oclg .sw{width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:3px;border:1px solid}
/* the live gradient: five classes, a dot and a Wilson interval apiece */
.ocgrad{display:flex;gap:var(--sp2);align-items:flex-end;margin:var(--sp3) 0;min-height:186px}
.ocgcol{flex:1 1 0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.ocgplot{position:relative;width:100%;height:150px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.ocgci{position:absolute;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:2px;border-radius:1px;
  opacity:.45}
.ocgcap{position:absolute;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:11px;height:1.5px}
.ocgdot{position:absolute;left:50%;width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;
  transform:translate(-50%,50%);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #fff}
.ocgval{position:absolute;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);font:600 11.5px var(--sans);
  color:var(--navy);white-space:nowrap;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.ocglab{font:11.5px var(--sans);color:#41474e;text-align:center;line-height:1.25}
.ocglab i{display:block;color:var(--grey);font-size:10.5px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.ocgempty{flex:1 1 auto;color:var(--grey);font-style:italic;font-size:12.5px;align-self:center}

/* ── rank bridge: two ladders and the common scale between them ─────────────────── */
.rkbar-legend{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:var(--sp3);font:11.5px var(--sans);
  color:var(--grey);margin:0 0 var(--sp3)}
.rklg{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.rklg .sw{width:13px;height:11px;border-radius:3px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff}
.rklg .sw.nc{background:#fbe3e6;border-color:#d0687a}
.rklg .sw.zero{background:#f4f5f7;border-style:dashed}
.rklg .sw.snr{background:#fff;border-color:var(--navy);border-width:2px}
.rklayout{display:flex;gap:var(--sp4);align-items:flex-start;margin:0 0 var(--sp4)}
.rkwrap{flex:1 1 auto;overflow-x:auto}
#rksvg{max-width:100%;height:auto;font-family:var(--sans)}
#rksvg .rkhead{font:700 10.5px var(--sans);letter-spacing:.09em;fill:var(--navy)}
#rksvg .rksub{font:italic 11.5px var(--serif);fill:var(--grey)}
#rksvg .rkbox rect{fill:#fff;stroke:#cfd6dd;stroke-width:1}
#rksvg .rkbox[data-side="h"] rect{fill:#f4f7fa}
#rksvg .rkbox.nc rect{fill:url(#rkhatch);stroke:#d0687a}
#rksvg .rkbox.zero rect{fill:#fafbfc;stroke:#e3e7ea;stroke-dasharray:3 2}
#rksvg .rkbox.zero .rkcs,#rksvg .rkbox.zero .rkn{fill:#9aa3ad}
#rksvg .rkbox.zero .rkg{fill:#c3cad1}
#rksvg .rkbox.snr rect{stroke:var(--navy);stroke-width:1.6}
#rksvg .rkbox{cursor:pointer}
/* the fine common grade: a bare numeral, no box, muted CU navy */
#rksvg .rkg{font:600 11px "SF Mono",Consolas,monospace;fill:#8fa3b4}
#rksvg .rkg.out{text-anchor:end}
#rksvg .rkbox:hover .rkg,#rksvg .rkbox.sel .rkg{fill:var(--navy)}
#rksvg .rkcs{font:12.5px var(--sans);fill:#1a1d21}
#rksvg .rkn{font:600 11px "SF Mono",Consolas,monospace;fill:var(--grey);text-anchor:end}
#rksvg .rkbar{fill:#5f89a8;opacity:.55}
#rksvg .rkgrade rect{fill:var(--navy)}
#rksvg .rkgrade text{font:600 11px var(--sans);fill:#fff;text-anchor:middle}
#rksvg .rkedge{stroke:#c6ced6;stroke-width:1;fill:none}
/* highlight: a grade and everything attached to it */
#rksvg.hl .rkbox:not(.hi) rect{opacity:.35}
#rksvg.hl .rkbox:not(.hi) text{opacity:.35}
#rksvg.hl .rkedge:not(.hi){opacity:.15}
#rksvg.hl .rkgrade:not(.hi) rect{opacity:.3}
#rksvg .rkbox.hi rect{stroke:var(--red);stroke-width:2}
#rksvg .rkedge.hi{stroke:var(--red);stroke-width:1.6}
#rksvg .rkbox.sel rect{stroke:var(--navy);stroke-width:2.5}
.rkpanel{flex:0 0 288px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r2);
  background:var(--soft);padding:var(--sp3);font:13px/1.6 var(--sans);position:sticky;top:16px}
.rkpanel.empty{background:#fff;border-style:dashed}
.rkpanel .pnote{margin:0;color:var(--grey);font-style:italic}
.rkpanel h4{font:700 9.5px var(--sans);letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--grey);margin:12px 0 5px}
.rkpanel .rkname{color:var(--navy);font-size:14px;font-weight:700}
.rkpanel .rkmeta{color:var(--grey);font-size:11.5px;margin:2px 0 10px}
.rkstack{display:flex;height:16px;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--line)}
.rkstack span{display:block}
.rkstack .d{background:#d0687a}.rkstack .s{background:#b4bcc2}.rkstack .u{background:#6fae8c}
.rkkey{display:flex;gap:var(--sp3);font-size:11.5px;color:var(--grey);margin-top:6px}
.rkkey b{color:#41474d}
.rkpanel ol{margin:0;padding-left:18px}
.rkpanel li{margin:0 0 4px}
/* the OF-3+ roster: ids only, one row per record, scrolls inside the panel */
.rkroster{max-height:300px;overflow-y:auto;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r1);
  background:#fff}
.rkroster table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font:11.5px var(--sans)}
.rkroster td{padding:3px 7px;border-bottom:1px solid #eef1f4;white-space:nowrap}
.rkroster tr:last-child td{border-bottom:0}
.rkroster td:first-child{font-family:"SF Mono",Consolas,monospace}
.rkroster td:nth-child(3),.rkroster td:last-child{color:var(--grey)}
.rkroster a{color:var(--navy)}
@media(max-width:1100px){.rklayout{flex-direction:column}.rkpanel{flex:1 1 auto;width:100%;
  position:static}}
/* ── reading-path map ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.pmwrap{overflow-x:auto;margin:0 0 var(--sp4)}
#pathmap{max-width:100%;height:auto;font-family:var(--sans)}
#pathmap .pmh{font:700 10.5px var(--sans);letter-spacing:.09em;fill:var(--navy)}
#pathmap .pmq{font:600 13px var(--sans);fill:#1a1d21}
#pathmap .pmg{font:italic 11.5px var(--serif);fill:var(--grey)}
#pathmap .pmnode rect{fill:#fff;stroke-width:1.4}
#pathmap .pmnode text{font:12.5px var(--sans);fill:var(--navy);text-anchor:middle}
#pathmap a:hover .pmnode rect{fill:var(--soft)}
#pathmap .pmarrow{stroke:#b4bcc2;stroke-width:1.2;fill:none}
/* print / PDF: every sheet, no chrome, one sheet per page */
@media print{
  #side,.printbtn,.seg,.archlegend,.toc,.tblfilter,#zoomer,.chips,
  .wayfind,.seealso{display:none!important}
  #wrap{display:block}
  main{max-width:none;padding:0}
  .sheet{display:block!important;break-before:page;page-break-before:always}
  .sheet:first-of-type{break-before:auto;page-break-before:auto}
  .tblwrap{max-height:none;overflow:visible;border:0}
  table.tbl th,.sheet table th{position:static}
  .fn,figure,.tldr,.feyn,table{break-inside:avoid;page-break-inside:avoid}
  details{display:block}
  details>summary{display:none}
  /* the source folds are unlabelled by design once expanded; this one is a titled section
     and loses its meaning without the title, so it keeps its summary (minus the triangle) */
  .feyn>summary{display:block;padding-bottom:0}
  .feyn>summary::before{content:none}
  a{text-decoration:none;color:#000}
  body{font-size:10.5pt}
}
</style></head><body><div id="wrap">
<nav id="side">
  <h1>{{ project }}</h1>
  <p class="sub">{{ subtitle }}</p>
  <input id="search" placeholder="Search all sheets…" oninput="doSearch(this.value)" autocomplete="off">
  <div id="results"></div>
  {% for grp, items, coll, gcol in groups %}
    {% if coll %}
      <details class="navgrp" id="navgrp-{{ loop.index }}">
        <summary class="grp"><span class="gdot" style="background:{{ gcol }}"></span>{{ grp }}
          <span class="cnt">{{ items|length }}</span></summary>
        {% set ns = namespace(role='') %}
        {% for s in items %}
          {% if s.role != ns.role %}<div class="subgrp">{{ s.role }}</div>{% set ns.role = s.role %}{% endif %}
          <a class="scriptlink" href="#{{ s.id }}" data-id="{{ s.id }}"
             onclick="show('{{ s.id }}');return true">{{ s.title }}</a>
        {% endfor %}
      </details>
    {% else %}
      <div class="grp"><span class="gdot" style="background:{{ gcol }}"></span>{{ grp }}</div>
      {% for s in items %}
        <a href="#{{ s.id }}" data-id="{{ s.id }}" onclick="show('{{ s.id }}');return true">
          {{ s.title }}{% if s.interactive %}<span class="ixdot" title="interactive"></span>{% endif %}<small>{{ s.blurb }}</small></a>
      {% endfor %}
    {% endif %}
  {% endfor %}
  <button class="printbtn" onclick="printDoc()" title="Expand everything and open the print dialog">
    Print / save as PDF</button>
  <div class="stamp">
    <div><b>Built</b> {{ stamp.built }}</div>
    <div><b>Data</b> {{ stamp.data_built }}</div>
    <div><b>Commit</b> {{ stamp.sha }} ({{ stamp.branch }})
      {% if stamp.git %}<span class="pill {{ 'dirty' if stamp.dirty else 'clean' }}">
        {{ 'uncommitted changes' if stamp.dirty else 'clean tree' }}</span>
      {% else %}<span class="pill dirty">built without git history</span>{% endif %}</div>
    <div style="margin-top:8px">Generated by<br><code>utils/docs/build_docs.py</code></div>
  </div>
</nav>
<div id="zoomer" onclick="this.classList.remove('on')">
  <img id="zoomimg" alt=""><div class="hint">click anywhere, or press Esc, to close</div></div>
<main>
<div id="freshness" data-built="{{ stamp.built_epoch }}" data-dirty="{{ 1 if stamp.dirty else 0 }}"
     data-qafail="{{ qa_failures }}"></div>
{% for s in sheets %}
  <section class="sheet" id="sheet-{{ s.id }}">
    <h1>{{ s.title }}<span class="grpchip" style="background:{{ s.gcol }}">{{ s.group }}</span></h1>
    <p class="lede">{{ s.blurb }}{% if s.src %} · source: <code>{{ s.src }}</code>{% endif %}</p>
    {{ s.html }}
  </section>
{% endfor %}
</main></div>
<script>
const SHEETS = {{ sheet_ids }};
// The script sheets are fetched when first opened (scripts/<id>.html); LAZY maps every id
// inside them to its sheet, so a link to a function's anchor still lands.
const LAZY = {{ lazy_anchors }};
function loadSheet(id){
  const sec=document.getElementById('sheet-'+id), ph=sec && sec.querySelector('.lazysheet');
  if(!ph) return Promise.resolve();
  if(ph._loading) return ph._loading;
  ph._loading = fetch(ph.dataset.src).then(r=>{ if(!r.ok) throw new Error(r.status); return r.text(); })
    .then(html=>{ ph.outerHTML = html; })
    .catch(()=>{ ph._loading = null;
      ph.innerHTML = '<p class="note">This sheet is its own file (<code>'+ph.dataset.src+'</code>) '
        +'and could not be fetched. Open the documentation through the live site or a local '
        +'web server (<code>python -m http.server</code> in <code>output/docs</code>), not '
        +'straight from disk.</p>'; });
  return ph._loading;
}
function show(id, keepScroll){
  loadSheet(id);
  SHEETS.forEach(s=>{const e=document.getElementById('sheet-'+s); if(e) e.classList.toggle('on', s===id);});
  document.querySelectorAll('#side a[data-id]').forEach(a=>{
    const on = a.dataset.id===id;
    a.classList.toggle('active', on);
    // a script sheet reached from search or a URL hash lives in a collapsed group — open it
    if(on){ const d = a.closest('details'); if(d) d.open = true; }
  });
  if(!keepScroll) window.scrollTo(0,0);
}
// Routing rule: a hash is EITHER a sheet id OR a heading inside one. Only the first was
// handled, so a link to another sheet's section (#places-coverage…) changed the URL and
// nothing else — every contents-strip anchor was unreachable from outside its own sheet.
function route(hash){
  const h = (hash||'').replace(/^#/,'');
  if(!h){ show(SHEETS[0]); return true; }
  if(SHEETS.includes(h)){ show(h); return true; }
  if(LAZY[h] && !document.getElementById(h)){
    show(LAZY[h], true);
    loadSheet(LAZY[h]).then(()=>{ const t=document.getElementById(h); if(t) t.scrollIntoView({block:'start'}); });
    return true;
  }
  const el = document.getElementById(h);
  const sec = el && el.closest('section.sheet');
  if(!sec) return false;
  show(sec.id.replace(/^sheet-/,''), true);
  el.scrollIntoView({block:'start'});
  return true;
}
// Freshness / health banner. A static page cannot watch the filesystem, so it reports the
// two things it CAN know: how old this build is (the pipeline may have moved on since), and
// what was already wrong at build time — a dirty tree or a failing data-QA check.
(function(){
  const el=document.getElementById('freshness'); if(!el) return;
  const ageDays=(Date.now()/1000 - +el.dataset.built)/86400;
  const msgs=[];
  if(+el.dataset.qafail>0)
    msgs.push(['bad', `${el.dataset.qafail} data-QA check(s) were failing when this page was `
      +`built — see <a href="#qa" onclick="show('qa')">Data QA</a> before trusting the numbers.`]);
  if(+el.dataset.dirty)
    msgs.push(['warn', 'Built from an <b>uncommitted</b> working tree, so these numbers '
      +'correspond to no commit. <a href="#changelog" onclick="show(\'changelog\')">Commits &amp; '
      +'versions</a>']);
  if(ageDays>7)
    msgs.push(['warn', `This page was generated <b>${Math.floor(ageDays)} days ago</b>. If the `
      +'pipeline or <code>data/final</code> has changed since, rebuild: '
      +'<code>python utils/docs/build_docs.py</code>']);
  if(!msgs.length) return;
  el.className='fresh '+(msgs.some(m=>m[0]==='bad')?'bad':'warn');
  el.innerHTML=msgs.map(m=>'<div>'+m[1]+'</div>').join('');
})();
// Print / PDF: the page is a set of hidden tabs with collapsed <details>, so printing it
// raw would emit one sheet with everything folded shut. Expand first, restore afterwards.
function printDoc(){
  const closed=[...document.querySelectorAll('details:not([open])')];
  closed.forEach(d=>d.open=true);
  const restore=()=>closed.forEach(d=>d.open=false);
  window.addEventListener('afterprint', restore, {once:true});
  setTimeout(()=>{ window.print(); setTimeout(restore, 1500); }, 60);
}
function zoom(img){
  const z=document.getElementById('zoomer');
  document.getElementById('zoomimg').src=img.src;
  z.classList.add('on');
}
document.addEventListener('keydown', e=>{
  if(e.key==='Escape'){ document.getElementById('zoomer').classList.remove('on');
                        if(typeof archClear==='function') archClear(); }
});
function filterTable(inp){
  const q = inp.value.toLowerCase();
  const tbl = inp.parentElement.querySelector('table');
  tbl.querySelectorAll('tbody tr').forEach(tr=>{
    tr.style.display = tr.textContent.toLowerCase().includes(q) ? '' : 'none';
  });
}
// ── analysis-sample waterfall: sum the precomputed joint distribution in the browser
// combos are [flagBits, theatreIdx, count]; a record is 'deserted' iff bit0 is set.
// instance-scoped: each waterfall is #wf-<name> with data in window.WF[<name>]
function wfActive(root){ return [...root.querySelectorAll('.wfchips input')].filter(b=>b.checked)
                          .map(b=>({bit:+b.dataset.bit, req:b.dataset.req})); }
function wfPass(b, active){
  for(const t of active){ const on=(b>>t.bit)&1; if(t.req==='set'?!on:on) return false; }
  return true;
}
function wfCount(cfg, active){ let n=0,d=0;                // total N and highlighted subgroup
  for(const [b,,c] of cfg.combos){ if(wfPass(b,active)){ n+=c; if(b&1) d+=c; } }
  return [n,d];
}
function wfByTheatre(cfg, active){
  const t={};
  for(const [b,ti,c] of cfg.combos){ if(!wfPass(b,active)) continue;
    if(!t[ti]) t[ti]=[0,0]; t[ti][0]+=c; if(b&1) t[ti][1]+=c; }
  return t;
}
function wfSnippet(cfg, root, active){                     // the runnable pandas mask
  const on=[...root.querySelectorAll('.wfchips input')].filter(b=>b.checked)
             .sort((a,b)=>a.dataset.bit-b.dataset.bit);
  const [n,d]=wfCount(cfg,active);
  let s='import pandas as pd\ndf = pd.read_parquet("'+cfg.parquet+'")\n';
  if(cfg.helper && on.some(b=>/unit_status/.test(b.dataset.pred))) s+='\n'+cfg.helper;
  if(!on.length){ s+='\nsample = df.copy()'; }
  else{
    const preds=on.map(b=>{const lab=(b.nextSibling?b.nextSibling.textContent:'').trim();
      return '      '+b.dataset.pred+'   # '+lab; });
    s+='\nsample = df[\n'+preds.join('\n    &\n')+'\n]';
  }
  s+=`\n# N = ${n.toLocaleString('en-US').replace(/,/g,' ')}   (${d.toLocaleString('en-US').replace(/,/g,' ')} ${cfg.hlabel})`;
  return s;
}
function wfShareURL(name, root){
  const keys=[...root.querySelectorAll('.wfchips input')].filter(b=>b.checked).map(b=>b.dataset.key);
  const cfg=window.WF[name];
  return location.origin+location.pathname+(keys.length?'?wf_'+name+'='+keys.join(','):'')+'#'+(cfg.anchor||'descriptives');
}
function wfUpdate(name){
  const cfg=(window.WF||{})[name], root=document.getElementById('wf-'+name);
  if(!cfg||!root) return;
  const out=root.querySelector('.wfout'), boxes=[...root.querySelectorAll('.wfchips input')];
  const active=wfActive(root);
  const [n,d]=wfCount(cfg,active), N=+out.dataset.n;
  const rate = n ? (d/n*100).toFixed(2) : '0.00';
  const cap = cfg.hlabel.charAt(0).toUpperCase()+cfg.hlabel.slice(1);
  const rows = boxes.map(box=>{                            // per-toggle marginal cost
    const here={bit:+box.dataset.bit, req:box.dataset.req};
    const alt = box.checked ? active.filter(t=>t.bit!==here.bit) : active.concat([here]);
    const [an]=wfCount(cfg,alt);
    const lab=(box.nextSibling?box.nextSibling.textContent:'').trim(), delta=an-n;
    return `<tr class="${box.checked?'active':''}"><td>${box.checked?'✓ ':''}${lab}</td>`
      +`<td class="num">${an.toLocaleString()}</td>`
      +`<td class="num ${delta<0?'costdrop':''}">${box.checked?'if dropped':'if added'}: `
      +`${delta>0?'+':''}${delta.toLocaleString()}</td></tr>`;
  }).join('');
  const th=wfByTheatre(cfg,active), TH=cfg.theatres, TC=cfg.thcol||{};
  const tsorted=Object.keys(th).map(k=>[TH[k],th[k][0],th[k][1]]).filter(r=>r[1]>0)
    .sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]);
  const trows=tsorted.map(([nm,tn,td])=>
      `<tr><td>${nm}</td><td class="num">${tn.toLocaleString()}</td>`
      +`<td class="num">${td.toLocaleString()}</td>`
      +`<td class="num">${tn?(td/tn*100).toFixed(2):'0.00'}%</td></tr>`).join('');
  const segs=tsorted.map(([nm,tn])=>{ const w=tn/N*100, c=TC[nm]||'#888';
    return `<div class="seg" style="width:${w}%;background:${c}" title="${nm}: ${tn.toLocaleString()}">`
      +(w>6?`<span>${nm} ${tn.toLocaleString()}</span>`:'')+`</div>`; }).join('');
  const clg=tsorted.map(([nm,tn])=>`<span><span class="sw" style="background:${TC[nm]||'#888'}">`
      +`</span>${nm} ${(tn/n*100).toFixed(0)}%</span>`).join('');
  const comp=`<div class="wfcomp"><div class="h">Sample composition — filled = in sample, `
    +`grey = excluded</div><div class="wfcompbar">${segs}</div>`
    +`<div class="wfcompghost"><b>${n.toLocaleString()}</b> of ${N.toLocaleString()} `
    +`(${(n/N*100).toFixed(1)}%) retained · shares below are within the sample</div>`
    +`<div class="wfcomplab">${clg}</div></div>`;
  out.innerHTML =
    `<div class="wfhead"><div><div class="big">${n.toLocaleString()}</div>`
    +`<div class="lbl">records in sample · ${(n/N*100).toFixed(1)}% of ${N.toLocaleString()}</div></div>`
    +`<div><div class="sub"><b>${d.toLocaleString()}</b> ${cfg.hlabel}</div>`
    +`<div class="lbl">${cfg.ratelabel} ${rate}% within sample</div></div></div>`
    +comp
    +`<div class="wftbls"><table class="wfmarg"><thead><tr><th>Requirement</th>`
    +`<th class="num">Sample N</th><th class="num">Marginal effect</th></tr></thead>`
    +`<tbody>${rows}</tbody></table>`
    +`<table class="wfmarg"><thead><tr><th>Theatre</th><th class="num">N</th>`
    +`<th class="num">${cap}</th><th class="num">Rate</th></tr></thead>`
    +`<tbody>${trows||'<tr><td colspan=4>—</td></tr>'}</tbody></table></div>`;
  const link=root.querySelector('.wflink'); if(link) link.value=wfShareURL(name,root);
  const snip=root.querySelector('.wfsnip code'); if(snip&&cfg.parquet) snip.textContent=wfSnippet(cfg,root,active);
}
function wfCopyLink(btn){ const r=btn.closest('.wfblock'); wfClip(r.querySelector('.wflink').value,btn,'Copied!'); }
function wfCopySnip(btn){ const r=btn.closest('.wfblock'); wfClip(r.querySelector('.wfsnip code').textContent,btn,'Copied!'); }
function wfClip(text,btn,ok){
  const done=()=>{ const t=btn.textContent; btn.textContent=ok; setTimeout(()=>btn.textContent=t,1200); };
  if(navigator.clipboard&&navigator.clipboard.writeText){
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(done).catch(()=>wfClipFallback(text,done)); }
  else wfClipFallback(text,done);
}
function wfClipFallback(text,done){ const ta=document.createElement('textarea');
  ta.value=text; ta.style.position='fixed'; ta.style.opacity='0'; document.body.appendChild(ta);
  ta.select(); try{ document.execCommand('copy'); done(); }catch(e){} document.body.removeChild(ta); }
window.addEventListener('load', ()=>{ if(!window.WF) return;
  Object.keys(window.WF).forEach(name=>{
    const root=document.getElementById('wf-'+name); if(!root) return;
    const m=(location.search.match(new RegExp('[?&]wf_'+name+'=([^&#]+)'))||[])[1];  // restore a shared selection
    if(m){ const want=new Set(decodeURIComponent(m).split(','));
      root.querySelectorAll('.wfchips input').forEach(b=>b.checked=want.has(b.dataset.key)); }
    wfUpdate(name);
  });
});
// rank-reset section: switch histogram + areas between combat-only and inclusive
function rrMode(btn, mode){
  const sec=document.getElementById('rrsec'); if(!sec) return;
  sec.classList.toggle('combatonly', mode==='combat');
  sec.querySelectorAll('.rrmode').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('on', b===btn));
}
// rank-reset area chart: legend toggles one theatre's area on/off
function rrToggle(btn){
  btn.classList.toggle('off');
  const th=btn.dataset.th;
  document.querySelectorAll(`.rrarea [data-th="${CSS.escape(th)}"]`)
    .forEach(el=>el.classList.toggle('off', btn.classList.contains('off')));
}
// ── inline citations: hover shows the full APA reference; click jumps to References ──
(function(){
  let pop=null;
  const box=()=>{ if(!pop){ pop=document.createElement('div'); pop.id='bibpop';
                            document.body.appendChild(pop);} return pop; };
  document.addEventListener('mouseover', e=>{
    const a=e.target.closest && e.target.closest('.cite'); if(!a) return;
    const b=(window.BIB||{})[a.dataset.ref]; if(!b) return;
    const p=box(); p.innerHTML=b.apa; p.classList.add('on');
    const r=a.getBoundingClientRect(), vw=document.documentElement.clientWidth;
    p.style.left=Math.max(8, Math.min(window.scrollX+r.left, window.scrollX+vw-372))+'px';
    p.style.top=(window.scrollY+r.bottom+6)+'px';
  });
  document.addEventListener('mouseout', e=>{
    if(pop && e.target.closest && e.target.closest('.cite')) pop.classList.remove('on');
  });
})();
function bibGo(ev){
  ev.preventDefault();
  const a=ev.currentTarget; show('references');
  const t=document.getElementById('ref-'+a.dataset.ref);
  if(t){ t.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); t.classList.add('flash');
         setTimeout(()=>t.classList.remove('flash'),1600); }
  return false;
}
// ── provenance bipartite: click a box to isolate its links (pure class toggles) ──
(function(){
  const svg=document.getElementById('pvsvg'); if(!svg) return;
  const nodes=[...svg.querySelectorAll('.pvnode')], edges=[...svg.querySelectorAll('.pvedge')];
  const panel=document.getElementById('pvpanel');
  const esc=s=>String(s).replace(/[&<>]/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;'}[c]));
  const EMPTY='<div class="pbody"><p class="pnote">Click any box to open its detail here — '
            +'what it is, the kind of source, and every link it makes.</p></div>';
  let pin=null;
  function emptyPanel(){ if(!panel) return; panel.classList.add('empty'); panel.innerHTML=EMPTY; }
  function renderPanel(id){
    if(!panel||!window.PVINFO) return;
    const info=window.PVINFO[id]; if(!info){ emptyPanel(); return; }
    const col=(window.PVCOL&&window.PVCOL[info.cat])||['#eee','#999'];
    const roleLbl=info.role==='src'?'Source':'Mechanism · mapping';
    const hdr=info.role==='src'?'Grounds these mechanisms':'Rests on these sources';
    const links=(info.links||[]).map(l=>{const t=window.PVINFO[l];
      return `<a data-goto="${l}">${esc(t?t.label:l)}</a>`;}).join('')||'<span class="pnote">—</span>';
    const noteHdr=info.role==='src'?'How it enters the pipeline':'What it is';
    const refBlock=info.ref
      ? `<div class="plinks pvrefblk"><h4>Reference</h4>`
        +`<a class="cite" data-ref="${info.ref}" href="#references" onclick="return bibGo(event)">${info.refApa}</a></div>`
      : '';
    panel.classList.remove('empty');
    panel.innerHTML=`<div class="ph"><span class="sw" style="background:${col[0]};border-color:${col[1]}"></span>`
      +`<span class="ttl">${esc(info.label)}</span>`
      +`<button class="pclose" title="Close (Esc)" onclick="window.__pvClear()">×</button></div>`
      +`<div class="pbody"><span class="prole">${esc(roleLbl)} · ${esc(info.catLabel)}</span>`
      +`<h4 class="pnoteh">${noteHdr}</h4><p class="pnote">${esc(info.note)}</p>`
      + refBlock
      +`<div class="plinks"><h4>${hdr} (${(info.links||[]).length})</h4>${links}</div></div>`;
    panel.querySelectorAll('a[data-goto]').forEach(a=>a.addEventListener('click',ev=>{
      ev.preventDefault(); pick(a.dataset.goto); svg.scrollIntoView({block:'nearest'}); }));
  }
  function clear(){ pin=null; svg.classList.remove('sel');
    nodes.forEach(n=>n.classList.remove('hot','pin')); edges.forEach(e=>e.classList.remove('hot'));
    document.getElementById('pvhint').textContent='Click a box to trace its provenance.'; emptyPanel(); }
  function pick(id){
    if(pin===id){ clear(); return; }
    pin=id; svg.classList.add('sel');
    const kin=new Set([id]); let deg=0;
    edges.forEach(e=>{ const hot=e.dataset.s===id||e.dataset.m===id;
      e.classList.toggle('hot',hot); if(hot){ kin.add(e.dataset.s); kin.add(e.dataset.m); deg++; } });
    nodes.forEach(n=>{ n.classList.toggle('hot',kin.has(n.dataset.id));
                       n.classList.toggle('pin',n.dataset.id===id); });
    const me=nodes.find(n=>n.dataset.id===id);
    const lbl=me?me.querySelector('title').textContent.split(' — ')[0]:id;
    document.getElementById('pvhint').innerHTML=`<b>${esc(lbl)}</b> — ${deg} link${deg===1?'':'s'}. `
      +`<a href="#" onclick="event.preventDefault();window.__pvClear&&window.__pvClear()">clear</a>`;
    renderPanel(id);
  }
  window.__pvClear=clear;
  nodes.forEach(n=>n.addEventListener('click', ev=>{ ev.stopPropagation(); pick(n.dataset.id); }));
  svg.addEventListener('click', clear);
  document.addEventListener('keydown', e=>{ if(e.key==='Escape') clear(); });
  // legend doubles as a category filter
  window.pvCat=function(btn){
    btn.classList.toggle('on');
    const off=new Set([...document.querySelectorAll('.pvlg:not(.on)')].map(b=>b.dataset.cat));
    nodes.forEach(n=>n.classList.toggle('catoff', off.has(n.dataset.cat)));
    edges.forEach(e=>e.classList.toggle('catoff', off.has(e.dataset.cat)));
  };
})();

// ── place-matching cascade: frame switch · stage detail · tier filter · map ─────────
// One state object drives every view, so the ribbon, the boxes, the sample readout and the
// map can never show different answers to the same question.
const PFEMPTY='<p class="pnote">Click any stage for what it does, what it refuses, which '
  +'function owns it — and the strings it actually matched.</p>';
let PFFR='l', PFSEL='';
const pfN = n => n.toLocaleString('en-US');

function pfMode(btn){
  document.querySelectorAll('.pfbar .wfchip').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('on', b===btn));
  PFFR = btn.dataset.m==='h' ? 'h' : 'l';
  document.querySelectorAll('#pfsvg .pfstat,#pfsvg .pfribcap')
    .forEach(t=>{ if(t.dataset[PFFR]!==undefined) t.textContent = t.dataset[PFFR]; });
  const P=window.PF;
  document.querySelectorAll('#pfsvg .pfrib').forEach(r=>{
    r.setAttribute('d', P.rib[PFFR][r.dataset.lane]); });
  document.querySelectorAll('#pfsvg .pfbarv').forEach(b=>{
    const g=b.closest('.pfstage'), tot=+b.previousElementSibling.getAttribute('width');
    b.setAttribute('width', (tot*(P.bars[PFFR][g.dataset.id]||0)).toFixed(1)); });
  pfSync();
}
function pfPick(g){
  const id=g.dataset.id, P=window.PF, d=(P.info||{})[id], p=document.getElementById('pfpanel');
  if(!d||!p) return;
  const on = !g.classList.contains('sel');
  document.querySelectorAll('#pfsvg .pfstage').forEach(s=>s.classList.toggle('sel', s===g && on));
  document.querySelectorAll('#pfmap .pfd.sel').forEach(q=>q.classList.remove('sel'));
  PFSEL = on ? id : '';
  if(!on){ p.className='pfpanel empty'; p.innerHTML=PFEMPTY; pfMap(); return; }
  p.className='pfpanel';
  const ref = d.refus.length
    ? '<h4>Refuses</h4><ul>'+d.refus.map(r=>'<li>'+r+'</li>').join('')+'</ul>' : '';
  const sym = d.sym ? '<p class="psym"><code>'+d.sym+'</code></p>' : '';
  const ex = (P.ex[PFFR]||{})[d.tkey]||[];
  const extbl = ex.length ? '<h4>What it matched</h4><table class="pfex">'
    + ex.map(r=>'<tr><td class="a">'+pfEsc(r[0])+'</td><td class="b">→ '+pfEsc(r[1])
                +'</td><td class="n">'+pfN(r[2])+'</td></tr>').join('')
    + '</table>' : '';
  p.innerHTML = '<div class="phead"><b>'+d.label+'</b><span class="ptier" data-tier="'+d.tier
    +'">'+d.tier+'</span></div><p class="pmeta">'+d.lane+' · '+d.sub+'</p><p>'+d.what+'</p>'
    + ref + extbl + sym;
  pfMap();
}
function pfEsc(s){ const e=document.createElement('span'); e.textContent=s; return e.innerHTML; }

// ── the filter: tick tiers, get the sample and the mask that reproduces it ──────────
function pfKeep(ev, box){
  ev.stopPropagation();
  const g=box.closest('.pfstage');
  g.dataset.keep = g.dataset.keep==='1' ? '0' : '1';
  g.classList.toggle('drop', g.dataset.keep!=='1');
  pfSync();
}
function pfAll(on){
  document.querySelectorAll('#pfsvg .pfstage[data-keep]').forEach(g=>{
    g.dataset.keep = on ? '1' : '0'; g.classList.toggle('drop', !on); });
  pfSync();
}
function pfSync(){
  const P=window.PF; if(!P) return;
  const cz=[], sk=[]; let kept=0;
  document.querySelectorAll('#pfsvg .pfstage[data-keep]').forEach(g=>{
    if(g.dataset.keep!=='1' || g.dataset.tier==='coord') return;
    (g.dataset.key.startsWith('cz:') ? cz : sk).push(g.dataset.tier);
    kept += P.t[PFFR][g.dataset.key]||0;
  });
  const n=P.n[PFFR], pct=(kept/n*100).toFixed(1);
  const who = PFFR==='h' ? 'fallen-soldier' : 'legionnaire';
  const el=document.getElementById('pfkeepn');
  el.innerHTML = '<b>'+pfN(kept)+'</b> of '+pfN(n)+' '+who+' records ('+pct+'%) carry a birth '
    + 'district under the tiers ticked above'
    + (kept===0 ? ' — <span class="warn">nothing is left; tick a tier</span>.' : '.');
  const q = a => a.map(t=>'"'+t+'"').join(', ');
  document.getElementById('pfmaskc').textContent =
    'cz = ['+q(cz)+']\nsk = ['+q(sk)+']\n'
    + 'keep = df["birth_okres_match"].isin(cz) | df["birth_jaras_match"].isin(sk)\n'
    + 'df.loc[keep]   # '+pfN(kept)+' rows';
  pfMap();
}
function pfCopyMask(btn){
  const t=document.getElementById('pfmaskc').textContent;
  navigator.clipboard.writeText(t).then(()=>{
    const o=btn.textContent; btn.textContent='Copied'; setTimeout(()=>btn.textContent=o,1200); });
}

// ── the map: sum whatever is currently in view, then paint ──────────────────────────
let PFUNIT='okres', PFPOOL=false;
// Ten Czech seats are a city/rural twin. They are two okresy, but the court-level census
// cannot tell nine of the ten apart, so the analytical unit is the pooled pair (D-18).
// `pfPool` switches between the two, in the borders AND in the arithmetic — a merged region
// showing two different shades with no line between them would be worse than either answer.
function pfPoolOf(u){ return (PFPOOL && window.PF && PF.pool[u]) ? PF.pool[u] : u; }
function pfPoolName(u){
  return (PFPOOL && window.PF && PF.poolname[u]) ? PF.poolname[u] : ((PF.names[u])||u);
}
// Switching either control changes what a unit IS, so a selection made under the old one is
// no longer a selection of anything — clear it rather than leave a stale outline behind.
function pfClearSel(){
  ['pfselline','pfhoverline'].forEach(id=>{
    const e=document.getElementById(id); if(e) e.setAttribute('d','');
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('#pfmap .pfd.sel').forEach(q=>q.classList.remove('sel'));
  const p=document.getElementById('pfmappanel');
  if(p){ p.className='pfpanel empty'; p.innerHTML=PFMAPEMPTY; }
}
function pfUnit(btn){
  document.querySelectorAll('.pfunit[data-u]').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('on', b===btn));
  PFUNIT = btn.dataset.u;
  document.getElementById('pfmap').classList.toggle('courtmode', PFUNIT==='court');
  pfClearSel();
  pfMap();
}
function pfPool(btn){
  document.querySelectorAll('.pfunit[data-pool]').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('on', b===btn));
  PFPOOL = btn.dataset.pool==='1';
  document.getElementById('pfmap').classList.toggle('pooled', PFPOOL);
  pfClearSel();
  pfMap();
}
const PFMAPEMPTY='<p class="pnote">Click any district for who was born there — how many, '
  +'how often they deserted, which theatre they went to, and how far they fell on enrolment.</p>';
// Hover follows the same rule as selection: at political okres the whole okres lights up, so
// the outline is driven from JS rather than from a :hover rule on a court polygon.
(function(){
  const svg=document.getElementById('pfmap'); if(!svg) return;
  svg.addEventListener('mouseover', e=>{
    const t=e.target.closest && e.target.closest('.pfd');
    pfHover(t && PFUNIT!=='court' ? pfPoolOf(t.dataset.p) : '');
  });
  svg.addEventListener('mouseleave', ()=>pfHover(''));
  // the panel has told readers to "click the map background to clear" since the figure was
  // written, and until now nothing listened for it
  svg.addEventListener('click', e=>{
    if(!(e.target.closest && e.target.closest('.pfd'))) pfClearSel();
  });
})();
function pfMap(){
  const P=window.PF, svg=document.getElementById('pfmap'); if(!P||!svg) return;
  const geo=P.geo[PFFR]; let counts={};
  let head, keys=[];
  const sel = PFSEL ? (P.info[PFSEL]||{}) : null;
  const court = PFUNIT==='court';
  // The court layer is a different measurement on a smaller population, so totalling the
  // courts inside a district will NOT reproduce the district. The standing note below the
  // map says so in both modes — a reader who tries the addition should not have to switch
  // units to find out why it failed.
  const cv = (P.cvo||{})[PFFR]||{};
  const cvn = document.getElementById('pfsumnote');
  if(cvn) cvn.innerHTML =
    '<b>Courts do not sum to okresy</b> — they count different populations: '
    + pfN(cv.court_n||0)+' records carry a court against '+pfN(cv.okres_n||0)
    +' with an okres, because a court needs a geocoded village and a district name does not. '
    + pfN(cv.okres_only||0)+' have a district and no village; a further '+pfN(cv.elsewhere||0)
    +' sit in a court belonging to a different okres than their name, which is the two '
    +'layers disagreeing rather than a gap.';
  document.getElementById('pfunitnote').innerHTML = court
    ? '<b>'+pfN(P.court_n[PFFR])+'</b> records carry a court district — the coordinate layer, '
      +'so the tier filter and the stage selection do not apply here.'
    : (PFPOOL
        ? 'Each Czech city twin is drawn and counted with its ring — <b>148</b> okresy, what '
          +'the court-level census can support. The <b>26</b> Slovak town twins stay split: '
          +'the GISta census carries a row for each, so pooling them would discard a '
          +'covariate rather than repair one (D-19).'
        : 'Every political okres has its own border — <b>158</b> units, including the ten '
          +'cities the court-level census cannot separate. The Slovak side is always split '
          +'this way; only the Czech pairs respond to this control.');
  if(court){
    const g=P.court[PFFR]||{}; for(const u in g) counts[u]=g[u];
    head = 'Shading each <b>soudní okres</b> by the births a point-in-polygon test put inside it.';
  } else if(sel && sel.tkey){ keys=[sel.tkey];
    head = 'Showing <b>'+sel.label+'</b> alone — tier <code>'+sel.tier+'</code>.';
  } else {
    document.querySelectorAll('#pfsvg .pfstage[data-keep]').forEach(g=>{
      if(g.dataset.keep==='1' && g.dataset.tier!=='coord') keys.push(g.dataset.key); });
    head = sel ? 'That stage places nothing on the map — it is a residual, not a tier. '
                 +'Showing the ticked tiers.'
               : 'Showing every ticked tier together. Click a stage to isolate one, or a '
                 +'district for who was born there.';
  }
  keys.forEach(k=>{ const g=geo[k]; if(!g) return;
    for(const u in g) counts[u]=(counts[u]||0)+g[u]; });
  // pooling has to happen BEFORE the quantile cuts, or the bins are computed on units the
  // map does not draw and a pooled pair lands in a bin neither of its halves belongs to
  if(!court && PFPOOL){
    const m={}; for(const u in counts){ const k=pfPoolOf(u); m[k]=(m[k]||0)+counts[u]; }
    counts=m;
  }
  const vals=Object.values(counts).filter(v=>v>0).sort((a,b)=>a-b);
  if(sel && sel.tkey && !vals.length)
    head += ' This tier resolves a <b>county only</b>, so it places nothing at district level '
          + '— which is the point: a partial answer, marked as one.';
  // Quantile bins, not a linear ramp: birth counts are heavily skewed (Prague is an order
  // of magnitude above the median), so scaling to the maximum washes every other district
  // out to the same near-white and the map says nothing.
  const NB=6, cuts=[];
  for(let i=1;i<NB && vals.length;i++) cuts.push(vals[Math.min(vals.length-1,
                                                  Math.floor(i*vals.length/NB))]);
  // a weak tier can place 1–2 records in every district it touches, so the quantile cuts
  // collide; collapse them or the legend prints empty bins like "1–0"
  const brk=[...new Set(cuts)].filter(v=>v>1), NBu=brk.length+1;
  const bin = n => { let b=0; while(b<brk.length && n>=brk[b]) b++; return b; };
  const shade = n => NBu>1 ? pfRamp(bin(n)/(NBu-1)) : pfRamp(1);
  svg.querySelectorAll('.pfd').forEach(p=>{
    // in okres mode a court polygon is painted with its PARENT's value, which is what makes
    // the border classification necessary in the first place
    const u = court ? p.dataset.u : pfPoolOf(p.dataset.p), n = counts[u]||0;
    // inline style, not the fill attribute: the stylesheet's default fill would win over a
    // presentation attribute and every district would render the same unpainted grey
    p.style.fill = n===0 ? '#f1f3f5' : shade(n);
    const nm = court ? (P.names[p.dataset.u]||'')+' — soudní okres of '
                       +(P.names[p.dataset.p]||'') : pfPoolName(u);
    p.firstChild.textContent = nm+(n ? ' — '+pfN(n)+' records' : ' — none');
  });
  document.getElementById('pfmaphd').innerHTML = head;
  const lo=[1].concat(brk);
  document.getElementById('pfmapleg').innerHTML = vals.length
    ? '<span class="pfmzero"><i style="background:#f1f3f5"></i>none</span>'
      + lo.map((v,i)=>{ const hi = i<lo.length-1 ? lo[i+1]-1 : null;
          return '<span class="bin"><i style="background:'+shade(v)+'"></i>'
            + (hi===null ? pfN(v)+'+' : hi<=v ? pfN(v) : pfN(v)+'–'+pfN(hi))+'</span>'; }).join('')
      + '<span class="pfmnote">records born in the district ('
      + pfN(vals.length)+' districts, max '+pfN(vals[vals.length-1])+')</span>'
    : '<span class="pfmnote">nothing to map</span>';
}
function pfRamp(t){                        // pale slate → the sheet's own CU navy
  const a=[219,228,236], b=[0,42,69];
  return '#'+a.map((v,i)=>Math.round(v+(b[i]-v)*t).toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');
}

// ── click a district: the map runs the other way, from a place to the men ───────────
// The whole geography layer exists to hang a district on a soldier. This reads it backwards —
// who was born here, and what became of them — which is the only direction the thesis cares
// about. Rates are suppressed under 30 births: a percentage on eleven men is noise in a suit.
const PFTH={Russia:'#003657',Italy:'#D22D40',France:'#6E6E6E',Other:'#B4BCC2'};
// Pooling a pair is a sum for counts and a re-weighting for the rank-reset mean — which is
// why `rr` travels with its own denominator `rrn`. Averaging two means would silently give
// Brno město, with a fifth of the records, the same weight as the ring around it.
function pfPoolStats(uid){
  const P=window.PF, all=P.okres[PFFR]||{}, mem=(PFPOOL && P.poolmem[uid]) ? P.poolmem[uid] : [uid];
  const parts = mem.map(m=>all[m]).filter(Boolean);
  if(!parts.length) return null;
  if(parts.length===1 && mem.length===1) return parts[0];
  const o={n:0}; let rrs=0, rrn=0;
  parts.forEach(d=>{
    o.n += d.n;
    if(d.d!==undefined) o.d = (o.d||0) + d.d;
    if(d.rr!==undefined && d.rrn){ rrs += d.rr*d.rrn; rrn += d.rrn; }
    if(d.th){ o.th=o.th||{}; for(const k in d.th) o.th[k]=(o.th[k]||0)+d.th[k]; }
  });
  if(rrn){ o.rr = rrs/rrn; o.rrn = rrn; }
  // rank has to be recomputed against the pooled totals, not inherited from a member
  const tot={}; for(const m in all){ const k=pfPoolOf(m); tot[k]=(tot[k]||0)+all[m].n; }
  o.rank = Object.values(tot).filter(v=>v>tot[uid]).length + 1;
  return o;
}
// The outline of one data unit: at political okres its own boundary, from the layer built
// for it; at soudní okres the clicked polygon is the unit, so the outline layer stays empty
// and the polygon strokes itself.
function pfOutline(uid){
  const P=window.PF;
  return (PFPOOL && P.selpool[uid]) ? P.selpool[uid] : (P.sel[uid]||'');
}
function pfHover(uid){
  const l=document.getElementById('pfhoverline'); if(l) l.setAttribute('d', uid?pfOutline(uid):'');
}
function pfDistrict(el){
  const P=window.PF, p=document.getElementById('pfmappanel'); if(!P||!p) return;
  const court = PFUNIT==='court';
  const uid = pfPoolOf(el.dataset.p), d=pfPoolStats(uid);
  document.querySelectorAll('#pfsvg .pfstage').forEach(s=>s.classList.remove('sel'));
  PFSEL='';
  // in court mode only the court clicked is highlighted; in okres mode nothing is stroked
  // per-polygon and the unit's own outline is drawn instead
  document.querySelectorAll('#pfmap .pfd')
    .forEach(q=>q.classList.toggle('sel', court && q===el));
  document.getElementById('pfselline').setAttribute('d', court ? '' : pfOutline(uid));
  const name = court ? (P.names[el.dataset.u]||el.dataset.u) : pfPoolName(uid);
  if(!d){ p.className='pfpanel'; p.innerHTML='<div class="phead"><b>'+pfEsc(name)+'</b></div>'
    +'<p class="pmeta">no births resolved to this district</p>'
    +'<p>Either nobody in this dataset was born here, or every candidate was refused. '
    +'Both are readable off the cascade above.</p>'; pfMap(); return; }
  const who = PFFR==='h' ? 'fallen soldiers' : 'legionnaires';
  const isPool = !court && PFPOOL && !!P.poolmem[uid];
  // In court mode the headline is the court that was clicked and its own coordinate-derived
  // count; everything below it is measured at okres level and says so, because there is no
  // per-court outcome — the tiers resolve to a district, not to a court.
  const cn = court ? ((P.court[PFFR]||{})[el.dataset.u]||0) : 0;
  // the two frames are drawn on one plane but they are not the same unit, and the chip is
  // the only thing on the panel that says which one you are looking at
  const sk = String(uid).startsWith('hu');
  // a chartered town is a unit in its own right, not a subdivision of the járás beside it,
  // and the Hungarian backbone distinguishes the two grades of town — so say which
  const skType = sk ? ((P.hutype||{})[uid]||'járás') : '';
  let body = '<div class="phead"><b>'+pfEsc(name)+'</b><span class="ptier">'
    + (court ? 'soudní okres'
       : sk ? (skType === 'járás' ? 'járás' : 'mesto · ' + skType)
       : isPool ? 'census okres' : 'okres')
    + '</span></div>'
    + (court
        ? '<p class="pmeta">'+pfN(cn)+' '+who+' placed here by coordinate</p>'
          +'<p class="pfsmall">Inside <b>'+pfEsc(P.names[el.dataset.p]||'')+'</b>. Everything '
          +'below is measured for that okres — the tiers resolve to a district, not to a '
          +'court.</p>'
        : '<p class="pmeta">'+pfN(d.n)+' '+who+' born here · #'+d.rank
          +' of the districts</p>')
    + (isPool ? '<p class="pfsmall">City and ring pooled — this is the unit the 1910 census '
                +'can actually deliver.</p>' : '');
  if(d.d!==undefined && PFFR==='l'){
    const r=d.d/d.n, se=Math.sqrt(r*(1-r)/d.n), nat=P.rate[PFFR];
    body += '<h4>Desertion</h4>';
    body += d.n<30
      ? '<p class="pfsmall">'+d.d+' of '+d.n+' — too few births to read a rate from.</p>'
      : '<p class="pfstatline"><b>'+(r*100).toFixed(2)+'%</b> <span>&plusmn;'
        +(1.96*se*100).toFixed(2)+'</span> <i>vs '+(nat*100).toFixed(2)+'% overall</i></p>'
        + pfBar(r, nat);
  }
  if(d.th){
    const tot=Object.values(d.th).reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0);
    body += '<h4>Theatre</h4><div class="pfmix">'
      + Object.entries(d.th).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]).map(([k,v])=>
          '<span style="width:'+(v/tot*100).toFixed(1)+'%;background:'+(PFTH[k]||PFTH.Other)
          +'" title="'+k+' — '+pfN(v)+'"></span>').join('')
      + '</div><div class="pfmixlab">'
      + Object.entries(d.th).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]).map(([k,v])=>
          '<span><i style="background:'+(PFTH[k]||PFTH.Other)+'"></i>'+k+' '
          +(v/tot*100).toFixed(0)+'%</span>').join('')+'</div>';
  }
  if(d.rr!==undefined) body += '<h4>Rank reset</h4><p class="pfstatline"><b>'+d.rr.toFixed(2)
    +'</b> <i>mean on combat ranks</i></p>';
  body += '<p class="psym">Click the map background to clear.</p>';
  p.className='pfpanel'; p.innerHTML=body;
  pfMap();
}
function pfBar(r, nat){                      // one district against the national rate
  const w = Math.min(100, r/Math.max(nat*2.5, 1e-9)*100);
  return '<div class="pfrate"><span style="width:'+w.toFixed(1)+'%"></span>'
       + '<i style="left:'+Math.min(100, 1/2.5*100).toFixed(1)+'%"></i></div>';
}
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Occupation funnel — the coding rules, the class ladder, and the live gradient
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
const OCEMPTY='<p class="pnote">Click a rule for what it does, what it refuses, which '
  +'function owns it — and the strings it actually matched. Click a rung for the trades '
  +'on it.</p>';

function ocPick(g){
  const O=window.OC, d=(O.info||{})[g.dataset.id], p=document.getElementById('ocpanel');
  if(!d||!p) return;
  const on = !g.classList.contains('sel');
  document.querySelectorAll('#ocsvg .ocstage, #ocsvg .occls')
    .forEach(s=>s.classList.toggle('sel', s===g && on));
  if(!on){ p.className='pfpanel empty'; p.innerHTML=OCEMPTY; return; }
  p.className='pfpanel';
  let body='';
  if(d.kind==='stage'){
    const ref = d.refus.length
      ? '<h4>Refuses</h4><ul>'+d.refus.map(r=>'<li>'+r+'</li>').join('')+'</ul>' : '';
    const ex = (O.ex||{})[g.dataset.id]||[];
    const extbl = ex.length ? '<h4>What it matched</h4><table class="pfex">'
      + ex.map(r=>'<tr><td class="a">'+pfEsc(r[0])+'</td><td class="b">→ '+pfEsc(r[1])
                  +'</td><td class="n">'+pfN(r[2])+'</td></tr>').join('')
      + '</table>' : '';
    body = '<p>'+d.what+'</p>'+ref+extbl
         + (d.sym ? '<p class="psym"><code>'+d.sym+'</code></p>' : '');
  } else {
    // a rung: what sits on it, and how often those men deserted
    const rate=(O.cls_rate||{})[g.dataset.id.slice(1)];
    const mix=(O.cls||{})[g.dataset.id.slice(1)]||[];
    if(d.what) body += '<p>'+d.what+'</p>';
    if(rate && rate[0]){
      body += '<p class="pfstatline"><b>'+(rate[1]/rate[0]*100).toFixed(2)+'%</b> '
           +  '<span>deserted</span> <i>'+pfN(rate[1])+' of '+pfN(rate[0])+'</i></p>';
    }
    if(mix.length){
      body += '<h4>Commonest on this rung</h4><table class="pfex">'
        + mix.map(r=>'<tr><td class="a">'+pfEsc(r[0])+'</td><td class="n">'+pfN(r[1])
                     +'</td></tr>').join('') + '</table>';
    }
    if(d.refus && d.refus.length)
      body += '<h4>Note</h4><ul>'+d.refus.map(r=>'<li>'+r+'</li>').join('')+'</ul>';
    if(d.sym) body += '<p class="psym"><code>'+d.sym+'</code></p>';
  }
  p.innerHTML = '<div class="phead"><b>'+d.label+'</b><span class="ptier">'+d.tier
    +'</span></div><p class="pmeta">'+pfN(d.n)+' records · '+d.sub+'</p>'+body;
}

function ocKeep(ev, box){
  ev.stopPropagation();
  const g=box.closest('.ocstage');
  g.dataset.keep = g.dataset.keep==='1' ? '0' : '1';
  g.classList.toggle('drop', g.dataset.keep!=='1');
  ocSync();
}
function ocAll(on){
  // "Exact only" is the interesting end of this control, so 0 keeps `exact` rather than
  // emptying the sample — an empty chart would say nothing about the compound rules.
  document.querySelectorAll('#ocsvg .ocstage[data-keep]').forEach(g=>{
    const keep = on ? 1 : (g.dataset.id==='exact' ? 1 : 0);
    g.dataset.keep = String(keep); g.classList.toggle('drop', !keep); });
  ocSync();
}
function ocSync(){
  const O=window.OC; if(!O) return;
  const kept=[]; let n=0;
  document.querySelectorAll('#ocsvg .ocstage[data-keep]').forEach(g=>{
    if(g.dataset.keep!=='1') return;
    kept.push(g.dataset.id); n += O.t[g.dataset.id]||0;
  });
  const el=document.getElementById('ockeepn');
  if(el) el.innerHTML = '<b>'+pfN(n)+'</b> of '+pfN(O.n_nonempty)+' records with an occupation '
    + '('+(n/O.n_nonempty*100).toFixed(1)+'%) carry a HISCO code under the rules ticked above'
    + (kept.length===1 && kept[0]==='exact'
        ? ' — whole-string dictionary matches only.'
        : (n===0 ? ' — <span class="warn">nothing is left; tick a rule</span>.' : '.'));
  const q = a => a.map(t=>'"'+t+'"').join(', ');
  const mc=document.getElementById('ocmaskc');
  if(mc) mc.textContent =
    'rules = ['+q(kept)+']\n'
    + 'keep = df["occupation_match"].isin(rules)\n'
    + 'df.loc[keep].groupby("occupation_hisclass_5")["deserted"].mean()   # '+pfN(n)+' rows';
  ocGradient(kept);
}
// Wilson score interval — the binomial CI that behaves at small n and rates near zero,
// which is exactly the regime the "exact only" view moves into.
function ocWilson(k, n){
  if(!n) return [0,0,0];
  const z=1.96, p=k/n, d=1+z*z/n;
  const c=(p+z*z/(2*n))/d, h=z*Math.sqrt(p*(1-p)/n+z*z/(4*n*n))/d;
  return [p, Math.max(c-h,0), Math.min(c+h,1)];
}
function ocGradient(kept){
  const O=window.OC, box=document.getElementById('ocgrad'); if(!O||!box) return;
  const cells={};
  (kept||[]).forEach(t=>{
    const g=(O.grad||{})[t]; if(!g) return;
    Object.keys(g).forEach(k=>{
      cells[k]=cells[k]||[0,0];
      cells[k][0]+=g[k][0]; cells[k][1]+=g[k][1];
    });
  });
  const ks=['1','2','3','4','5'].filter(k=>cells[k]&&cells[k][0]>0);
  if(!ks.length){
    box.innerHTML='<div class="ocgempty">No rule ticked — nothing to plot.</div>'; return;
  }
  // One shared scale across the five classes, so the eye compares heights not panels.
  const top=Math.max(...ks.map(k=>ocWilson(cells[k][1],cells[k][0])[2]))*1.12 || 0.01;
  box.innerHTML = ks.map(k=>{
    const [n,d]=cells[k], [p,lo,hi]=ocWilson(d,n), col=(O.gcolour[k]||['#ccc','#666'])[1];
    const y=v=>(v/top*100);
    return '<div class="ocgcol"><div class="ocgplot">'
      + '<div class="ocgci" style="bottom:'+y(lo).toFixed(1)+'%;height:'
        + Math.max(y(hi)-y(lo),0.5).toFixed(1)+'%;background:'+col+'"></div>'
      + '<div class="ocgcap" style="bottom:'+y(hi).toFixed(1)+'%;background:'+col+'"></div>'
      + '<div class="ocgcap" style="bottom:'+y(lo).toFixed(1)+'%;background:'+col+'"></div>'
      + '<div class="ocgdot" style="bottom:'+y(p).toFixed(1)+'%;background:'+col+'" title="'
        + (p*100).toFixed(2)+'% [' +(lo*100).toFixed(2)+', '+(hi*100).toFixed(2)+']"></div>'
      + '<div class="ocgval" style="bottom:calc('+y(hi).toFixed(1)+'% + 7px)">'
        + (p*100).toFixed(2)+'%</div>'
      + '</div><div class="ocglab">'+pfEsc(O.glabel[k]||k)+'<i>n = '+pfN(n)+'</i></div></div>';
  }).join('');
}
function ocCopyMask(btn){
  const t=document.getElementById('ocmaskc').textContent;
  navigator.clipboard.writeText(t).then(()=>{
    const o=btn.textContent; btn.textContent='Copied'; setTimeout(()=>btn.textContent=o,1200); });
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', ()=>{ if(window.PF) pfSync(); });
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', ()=>{ if(window.OC) ocSync(); });
document.addEventListener('keydown', e=>{
  if(e.key!=='Escape') return;
  const s=document.querySelector('#pfsvg .pfstage.sel'); if(s) pfPick(s);
  const r=document.querySelector('#rksvg .rkbox.sel'); if(r) rkPick(r);
  const o=document.querySelector('#ocsvg .sel'); if(o) ocPick(o);
});

// ── rank bridge: hover lights a common grade; click reads the reset from either side ──
// The same joint distribution, conditioned two ways: from a Habsburg rank it answers "where
// did these men end up", from a Legion rank "who ended up here" — which is the direction the
// endogeneity question is actually asked in.
const RKEMPTY='<p class="pnote">Click either ladder. A <b>Habsburg</b> rank shows where those '
  +'men went; a <b>Legion</b> rank shows where they came from.</p>';
function rkPick(g){
  const p=document.getElementById('rkpanel'); if(!p) return;
  const side=g.dataset.side, name=g.dataset.name;
  const d=((side==='h'?window.RKDEST:window.RKORIG)||{})[name];
  const on=!g.classList.contains('sel');
  document.querySelectorAll('#rksvg .rkbox').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('sel', b===g && on));
  if(!on){ p.className='rkpanel empty'; p.innerHTML=RKEMPTY; return; }
  p.className='rkpanel';
  const roster=(window.RKROSTER||{})[side+':'+name]||[];
  const senior=+(g.dataset.g)>=(window.RKSENIOR||99);
  const head='<div class="rkname">'+name+'</div>';
  if(!d){
    p.innerHTML=head+'<p class="rkmeta">No record pairs this rank with one on the other '
      +'ladder, so there is no reset to read.</p>'+rkRoster(roster, senior);
    return;
  }
  const t=d.down+d.same+d.up || 1, pc=x=>Math.round(x/t*100);
  const list=d.top.map(([k,v])=>'<li>'+k+' <b>'+v.toLocaleString()+'</b></li>').join('');
  p.innerHTML=head
    +'<p class="rkmeta">'+d.n.toLocaleString()+(side==='h'
        ? ' captured at this rank, with a Legion rank on enrolment'
        : ' enrolled at this rank, with a Habsburg rank at capture')+'</p>'
    +'<h4>'+(side==='h'?'Where the reset took them':'How they got here')+'</h4>'
    +'<div class="rkstack"><span class="d" style="width:'+pc(d.down)+'%"></span>'
    +'<span class="s" style="width:'+pc(d.same)+'%"></span>'
    +'<span class="u" style="width:'+pc(d.up)+'%"></span></div>'
    +'<div class="rkkey"><span>demoted <b>'+pc(d.down)+'%</b></span>'
    +'<span>held <b>'+pc(d.same)+'%</b></span><span>raised <b>'+pc(d.up)+'%</b></span></div>'
    +'<h4>'+(side==='h'?'Most common entry rank':'Most common rank at capture')+'</h4>'
    +'<ol>'+list+'</ol>'
    +rkRoster(roster, senior);
}
// At OF-3 and above the counts are too thin for an aggregate to be checkable, so the records
// themselves are listed. IDs only — the published page carries no names.
function rkRoster(rows, senior){
  if(!senior || !rows.length) return '';
  const tr=rows.map(([id,by,other,th])=>'<tr><td>'
      +(id?'<a href="https://www.csol.cz/legionar/'+id+'/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">'
           +id+'</a>':'—')
      +'</td><td>'+(by||'—')+'</td><td>'+(other||'—')+'</td><td>'+(th||'—')+'</td></tr>').join('');
  return '<h4>The '+rows.length+' record'+(rows.length===1?'':'s')+', individually</h4>'
    +'<p class="rkmeta">Each id opens its csol.cz entry. Columns: id · birth year · rank on the '
    +'other ladder · theatre.</p>'
    +'<div class="rkroster"><table><tbody>'+tr+'</tbody></table></div>';
}
(function(){
  const svg=document.getElementById('rksvg'); if(!svg) return;
  const lite=(g)=>{
    svg.classList.toggle('hl', g!=null);
    svg.querySelectorAll('.rkbox,.rkedge,.rkgrade').forEach(
      e=>e.classList.toggle('hi', g!=null && e.dataset.g===g));
  };
  svg.querySelectorAll('.rkbox,.rkgrade').forEach(b=>{
    b.addEventListener('mouseenter', ()=>lite(b.dataset.g));
    b.addEventListener('mouseleave', ()=>lite(null));
  });
})();

const IDX = SHEETS.map(id=>{
  const e = document.getElementById('sheet-'+id);
  const h = e.querySelector('h1').cloneNode(true);           // drop the group chip from the title
  h.querySelectorAll('.grpchip').forEach(c=>c.remove());
  return {id, title: h.textContent.trim(), text: e.textContent};
});
// The script sheets' text is not in the page: fetched once, on the first search, and swapped
// into their entries. Until it arrives (or if it cannot be fetched) the search covers the rest.
let LAZY_TEXT = null;
function lazyText(then){
  if(LAZY_TEXT) return;
  LAZY_TEXT = fetch('{{ lazy_dir }}/search.json').then(r=>r.json()).then(t=>{
    IDX.forEach(s=>{ if(t[s.id]) s.text = t[s.id]; }); then();
  }).catch(()=>{});
}
function doSearch(q){
  const box = document.getElementById('results');
  q = q.trim();
  if(q.length < 3){ box.innerHTML=''; return; }
  lazyText(()=>doSearch(document.getElementById('search').value));
  const ql = q.toLowerCase(); let out='';
  IDX.forEach(s=>{
    const t = s.text.toLowerCase(); let i = t.indexOf(ql), n = 0;
    while(i !== -1 && n < 3){
      const snip = s.text.slice(Math.max(0,i-45), i+q.length+45).replace(/\s+/g,' ');
      const safe = snip.replace(/[&<>]/g, c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;'}[c]));
      const hl = safe.replace(new RegExp(q.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g,'\\$&'),'ig'), m=>'<mark>'+m+'</mark>');
      out += `<a href="#${s.id}" onclick="show('${s.id}')"><b>${s.title}</b><span class="hit">…${hl}…</span></a>`;
      i = t.indexOf(ql, i+1); n++;
    }
  });
  box.innerHTML = out || '<a class="hit" style="padding:6px 8px">No matches</a>';
}
// architecture map: flowchart ⇄ network toggle, hover isolation, click-through
let archLayout = ()=>{}, archRole = ()=>{}, archClear = ()=>{},
    archHulls = ()=>{}, archImpact = ()=>{};
(function(){
  const svg = document.getElementById('archsvg');
  if(!svg) return;
  const NW=158, NH=26, ROLE={
    "Notebooks":["#fbe3e6","#d98a95"], "Scraping":["#e7eaee","#a6b0bb"],
    "Person parsing":["#e3edf4","#8fb0c6"], "Geography & census":["#e3f0e8","#89bfa0"],
    "Linkage":["#f6edd0","#d3b768"], "Output & support":["#efe7f4","#b79dcf"]};
  const nodes=[...svg.querySelectorAll('.node')], edges=[...svg.querySelectorAll('.edge')];
  const byId={}; nodes.forEach(n=>byId[n.dataset.id]=n);
  let mode='flow';
  const cur={};                        // live position per node (animated)
  nodes.forEach(n=>{cur[n.dataset.id]={x:+n.dataset.lx,y:+n.dataset.ly};});

  // edge endpoint on a node's border, toward the other node's centre
  function border(cx,cy,tx,ty,w,h){
    const dx=tx-cx,dy=ty-cy;
    const s=Math.min(dx?(w/2)/Math.abs(dx):1e9, dy?(h/2)/Math.abs(dy):1e9);
    return [cx+dx*s, cy+dy*s];
  }
  function sizeOf(id){ const n=byId[id], s=(mode==='net'? +n.dataset.scale : 1);
                       return [NW*s, NH*s]; }
  function drawEdges(){
    edges.forEach(e=>{
      const A=cur[e.dataset.a], B=cur[e.dataset.b]; if(!A||!B) return;
      const [aw,ah]=sizeOf(e.dataset.a), [bw,bh]=sizeOf(e.dataset.b);
      const ax=A.x+aw/2, ay=A.y+ah/2, bx=B.x+bw/2, by=B.y+bh/2;
      const [x1,y1]=border(ax,ay,bx,by,aw,ah), [x2,y2]=border(bx,by,ax,ay,bw,bh);
      if(mode==='flow'){            // horizontal bezier — the flowchart look
        const mx=(x1+x2)/2;
        e.setAttribute('d', x2>x1 ? `M${x1},${y1} C${mx},${y1} ${mx},${y2} ${x2},${y2}`
                                  : `M${x1},${y1} C${x1+40},${y1-26} ${x2-40},${y2-26} ${x2},${y2}`);
      } else {                       // straight line — the network look
        e.setAttribute('d', `M${x1},${y1} L${x2},${y2}`);
      }
    });
  }
  drawEdges();

  archLayout = function(m){
    if(m===mode) return;
    mode=m;
    const W=+svg.dataset.w, H=(m==='net'?+svg.dataset.neth:+svg.dataset.flowh);
    svg.setAttribute('viewBox', `0 0 ${W} ${H}`);
    svg.setAttribute('height', H);
    svg.classList.toggle('net', m==='net');
    document.getElementById('archFlow').classList.toggle('on', m==='flow');
    document.getElementById('archNet').classList.toggle('on', m==='net');
    document.querySelector('.archlegend').classList.toggle('show', m==='net');
    nodes.forEach(n=>{
      const tx=(m==='net'?+n.dataset.fx:+n.dataset.lx), ty=(m==='net'?+n.dataset.fy:+n.dataset.ly);
      // in the network view a node's area scales with its size in lines
      const sc=(m==='net'? +n.dataset.scale : 1);
      n.style.transform=`translate(${tx}px,${ty}px) scale(${sc})`;
      const r=n.querySelector('rect');
      if(m==='net'){ const c=ROLE[n.dataset.role]||ROLE["Output & support"];
        r.style.fill=c[0]; r.style.stroke=c[1];
        r.setAttribute('stroke-width', 1 + Math.min(3, (+n.dataset.deg)/2)); }
      else { r.style.fill=''; r.style.stroke=''; r.setAttribute('stroke-width',1); }
    });
    // glide nodes for 600ms (CSS), redrawing edges each frame so they follow
    const t0=performance.now(), from={}; nodes.forEach(n=>from[n.dataset.id]={...cur[n.dataset.id]});
    (function tick(now){
      const k=Math.min(1,(now-t0)/620), e=k<.5?2*k*k:1-Math.pow(-2*k+2,2)/2;  // easeInOut
      nodes.forEach(n=>{const id=n.dataset.id,
        tx=(m==='net'?+n.dataset.fx:+n.dataset.lx), ty=(m==='net'?+n.dataset.fy:+n.dataset.ly);
        cur[id]={x:from[id].x+(tx-from[id].x)*e, y:from[id].y+(ty-from[id].y)*e};});
      drawEdges();
      if(k<1) requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    })(t0);
  };
  // focus = the neighbourhood of one node. Hovering previews it; clicking PINS it so you
  // can actually read the result (a hover-only graph is unusable the moment you look away).
  let pinned=null;
  function focus(id){
    if(!id){ svg.classList.remove('iso');
      edges.forEach(e=>e.classList.remove('hot')); nodes.forEach(m=>m.classList.remove('hot'));
      return; }
    svg.classList.add('iso');
    const kin=new Set([id]);
    edges.forEach(e=>{const hot=e.dataset.a===id||e.dataset.b===id;
      e.classList.toggle('hot',hot); if(hot){kin.add(e.dataset.a);kin.add(e.dataset.b);}});
    nodes.forEach(m=>m.classList.toggle('hot', kin.has(m.dataset.id)));
  }
  function describe(id){
    const out=edges.filter(e=>e.dataset.a===id).map(e=>e.dataset.b);
    const inc=edges.filter(e=>e.dataset.b===id).map(e=>e.dataset.a);
    document.getElementById('archPinned').innerHTML = id
      ? `<b>${id}</b> — imports ${out.length ? out.map(x=>'<code>'+x+'</code>').join(' ') : '<i>nothing</i>'}`
        + ` · imported by ${inc.length ? inc.map(x=>'<code>'+x+'</code>').join(' ') : '<i>nothing</i>'}`
        + ` · <a href="#" onclick="archClear();return false">clear</a>`
      : 'Hover to trace · click a box to inspect it (Esc clears) · double-click to open the module';
  }
  const esc=s=>String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;'}[c]));
  function archInfo(id){
    const p=document.getElementById('archpanel'); if(!p) return;
    const m=(window.ARCHMETA||{})[id];
    if(!m){ p.innerHTML='<div class="aempty">Click a module to inspect it.</div>'; return; }
    const c=ROLE[m.role]||ROLE["Output & support"];
    const imp=(out[id]||[]).slice().sort(), by=(inn[id]||[]).slice().sort();
    const chips=a=>a.length? a.map(x=>`<code onclick="archJump('${x}')">${esc(x)}</code>`).join('')
                           : '<span class="none">nothing</span>';
    p.innerHTML =
      (m.dirty?'<span class="adirty">changed · uncommitted</span>':'')
      +`<h3>${esc(id)}</h3>`
      +`<div class="arole"><span class="dot" style="background:${c[0]};border-color:${c[1]}"></span>`
      +`${esc(m.role)}${m.ver&&m.ver!=='—'?' · v'+esc(m.ver):''}</div>`
      +(m.doc?`<p class="adoc">${esc(m.doc)}</p>`:'')
      +`<div class="astat"><span><b>${m.lines||'—'}</b>lines</span>`
      +`<span><b>${imp.length}</b>imports</span><span><b>${by.length}</b>imported by</span></div>`
      +`<div class="alist"><div class="h">Imports</div>${chips(imp)}</div>`
      +`<div class="alist"><div class="h">Imported by</div>${chips(by)}</div>`
      +(m.sheet?`<button class="aopen" onclick="show('${m.sheet}')">Open module sheet →</button>`:'');
  }
  // clicking a chip inside the panel jumps focus to that module
  window.archJump=function(x){
    const n=nodes.find(z=>z.dataset.id===x); if(!n) return;
    svg.classList.remove('path'); nodes.forEach(z=>z.classList.remove('onpath','ep'));
    pinned=x; focus(x); describe(x); archInfo(x);
    nodes.forEach(z=>z.classList.toggle('pin', z.dataset.id===x));
  };
  // ── path tracing: every module on an import path from A to B ────────────────
  const out={}, inn={};
  edges.forEach(e=>{(out[e.dataset.a]=out[e.dataset.a]||[]).push(e.dataset.b);
                    (inn[e.dataset.b]=inn[e.dataset.b]||[]).push(e.dataset.a);});
  function reach(start, adj){
    const seen=new Set([start]), stack=[start];
    while(stack.length){ const v=stack.pop();
      (adj[v]||[]).forEach(w=>{ if(!seen.has(w)){ seen.add(w); stack.push(w); } }); }
    return seen;
  }
  function tracePath(a,b){
    // nodes on some a->b path = reachable-from-a ∩ reaches-b. Try both directions.
    let fwd=reach(a,out), bwd=reach(b,inn), dir=[a,b];
    let on=[...fwd].filter(x=>bwd.has(x));
    if(!on.includes(b)){ fwd=reach(b,out); bwd=reach(a,inn); dir=[b,a];
                         on=[...fwd].filter(x=>bwd.has(x)); }
    const set=new Set(on);
    if(!set.has(dir[0])||!set.has(dir[1])){
      svg.classList.remove('path');
      document.getElementById('archPinned').innerHTML =
        `<b>${a}</b> and <b>${b}</b> — no import path in either direction. `
        +`<a href="#" onclick="archClear();return false">clear</a>`;
      return;
    }
    svg.classList.remove('iso'); svg.classList.add('path');
    nodes.forEach(n=>{ n.classList.toggle('onpath', set.has(n.dataset.id));
                       n.classList.toggle('ep', n.dataset.id===a||n.dataset.id===b); });
    let hops=0;
    edges.forEach(e=>{ const on2=set.has(e.dataset.a)&&set.has(e.dataset.b);
                       e.classList.toggle('onpath', on2); if(on2) hops++; });
    document.getElementById('archPinned').innerHTML =
      `Path <b>${dir[0]}</b> → <b>${dir[1]}</b>: ${set.size} modules, ${hops} imports on the way. `
      +`<a href="#" onclick="archClear();return false">clear</a>`;
  }

  archClear = function(){ pinned=null; focus(null); describe(null); archInfo(null);
    svg.classList.remove('path');
    nodes.forEach(m=>m.classList.remove('pin','onpath','ep'));
    edges.forEach(e=>e.classList.remove('onpath')); };

  nodes.forEach(n=>{
    const id=n.dataset.id;
    n.addEventListener('mouseenter', ()=>{ if(!pinned && !svg.classList.contains('path')) focus(id); });
    n.addEventListener('mouseleave', ()=>{ if(!pinned && !svg.classList.contains('path')) focus(null); });
    n.addEventListener('click', ev=>{
      if(ev.shiftKey && pinned && pinned!==id){ tracePath(pinned, id); return; }
      if(pinned===id){ archClear(); return; }
      svg.classList.remove('path');
      nodes.forEach(m=>m.classList.remove('onpath','ep'));
      edges.forEach(e=>e.classList.remove('onpath'));
      pinned=id; focus(id); describe(id); archInfo(id);
      nodes.forEach(m=>m.classList.toggle('pin', m.dataset.id===id));
    });
    n.addEventListener('dblclick', ()=>{ if(n.dataset.sheet) show(n.dataset.sheet); });
  });

  archHulls = function(){
    svg.classList.toggle('hulls');
    document.getElementById('archHull').classList.toggle('on', svg.classList.contains('hulls'));
    if(svg.classList.contains('hulls') && mode!=='net') archLayout('net');
  };

  // change impact: what did this session touch, and what depends on it?
  archImpact = function(){
    const on=svg.classList.toggle('impact');
    document.getElementById('archImpact').classList.toggle('on', on);
    nodes.forEach(n=>n.classList.remove('impacted'));
    if(!on){ document.getElementById('archPinned').innerHTML=
      'Hover to trace · <b>click</b> a box to pin it · <b>shift-click</b> a second box to trace '
      +'the import path between them · <b>double-click</b> opens the module · Esc clears'; return; }
    const dirty=nodes.filter(n=>n.classList.contains('dirty')).map(n=>n.dataset.id);
    const hit=new Set();
    dirty.forEach(d=>reach(d,inn).forEach(x=>{ if(!dirty.includes(x)) hit.add(x); }));
    nodes.forEach(n=>n.classList.toggle('impacted', hit.has(n.dataset.id)));
    document.getElementById('archPinned').innerHTML = dirty.length
      ? `<b>${dirty.length}</b> module(s) changed but uncommitted (red); <b>${hit.size}</b> `
        +`import them directly or transitively (amber) and could be affected.`
      : 'Working tree is clean — nothing changed since the last commit.';
  };

  // legend doubles as a role filter — hide a whole layer to see what is left
  archRole = function(btn){
    btn.classList.toggle('on');
    const off=new Set([...document.querySelectorAll('.archlegend .lg:not(.on)')]
                      .map(b=>b.dataset.role));
    nodes.forEach(n=>n.classList.toggle('off', off.has(n.dataset.role)));
    const hidden=new Set(nodes.filter(n=>n.classList.contains('off')).map(n=>n.dataset.id));
    edges.forEach(e=>e.classList.toggle('off', hidden.has(e.dataset.a)||hidden.has(e.dataset.b)));
  };
})();
window.addEventListener('hashchange', ()=>{ route(location.hash); });
if(!route(location.hash)) show(SHEETS[0]);
</script>
{% if not stamp.mathml %}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/katex@0.16.9/dist/katex.min.css">
<script defer src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/katex@0.16.9/dist/katex.min.js"></script>
<script defer>window.addEventListener('load',()=>{if(!window.katex)return;
  document.querySelectorAll('.math-src').forEach(el=>{
    try{katex.render(el.textContent, el, {displayMode: el.dataset.display==='1', throwOnError:false});}catch(e){}
  });});</script>
{% endif %}
</body></html>""")


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
def working_tree() -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, set[str]]:
    """Uncommitted changes as (table, set of paths) — where this session's work lives."""
    status = {}
    for line in _git("status", "--porcelain").splitlines():
        if len(line) > 3:
            status[line[3:].strip().strip('"').split(" -> ")[-1]] = line[:2].strip()
    rows = []
    for line in _git("diff", "--numstat").splitlines():
        parts = line.split("\t")
        if len(parts) == 3:
            add, dele, path = parts
            rows.append({"File": path, "Added": add, "Removed": dele,
                         "Status": {"M": "modified", "A": "added", "R": "renamed",
                                    "??": "untracked"}.get(status.get(path, "M"), "modified")})
    tracked = {r["File"] for r in rows}
    for path, st in status.items():
        if path not in tracked and not path.endswith("/"):
            rows.append({"File": path, "Added": "—", "Removed": "—",
                         "Status": "untracked (new)" if st == "??" else "renamed"})
    df = pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("File").reset_index(drop=True) if rows else pd.DataFrame(
        columns=["File", "Added", "Removed", "Status"])
    return df, set(df["File"]) if len(df) else set()


def main() -> Path:
    """Assemble every sheet and write ``output/docs/index.html``.

    Returns:
        Path to the written page.
    """
    stamp = build_stamp()
    desc_html, qa_html, qa_failures = live_sheets()
    dirty_df, dirty_files = working_tree()
    scripts, symbols = collect_scripts(dirty_files)
    chlog = changelog_sheet(dirty_df, scripts)
    usage = usage_sheet(symbols)

    built: list[dict] = []
    for s in SHEETS:
        s = dict(s)
        if s["kind"] == "changelog":
            s["html"] = chlog
        elif s["kind"] == "graph":
            s["html"] = graph_sheet(dirty_files)
        elif s["kind"] == "units":
            s["html"] = units_sheet()
        elif s["kind"] == "provenance":
            s["html"] = provenance_sheet()
        elif s["kind"] == "references":
            s["html"] = references_sheet()
        elif s["kind"] == "usage":
            s["html"] = usage
        elif s["kind"] == "md":
            body = md_to_html((ROOT / s["src"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            body = _promote_tldr(_strip_lead_h1(body))
            if s["id"] == "habsburg-army":
                body += _regiment_explorer()
            elif s["id"] == "places":
                body = _after_tldr(body, place_flow())
            elif s["id"] == "lexikon-1910":
                body = _after_tldr(body, lexikon_page())
            elif s["id"] == "occupations":
                # `VALIDATION_OCCUPATIONS.md` used to be appended here in full, so that the
                # method and its evidence read as one argument. That was right while it was
                # the only home the document had — but it is now its own sheet, filed with
                # the other external checks, and appending it as well would render every
                # word twice. What stays behind is the summary table in §9, which carries
                # each check's headline number and blind spot and links through.
                body = _after_tldr(body, occupation_flow())
            elif s["id"] == "education":
                body += education_figures()
            elif s["id"] == "theatre":
                figs = theatre_figures()
                body = _before_h2(body, "The rulings", figs.get("explainer", ""))
                body = _before_h2(body, "Open", figs.get("trend", "") + figs.get("map", ""))
            elif s["id"] == "ranks":
                body = _after_tldr(body, ranks_bridge())
            elif s["id"] == "decisions":
                body = _decision_badges(body)
            elif s["id"] == "register-route":
                body = _register_route(body)
            elif s["id"] == "audit":
                # the earlier audits, each appended under one heading of its own; their sections
                # step down a level so the contents strip lists the newest audit's parts plus
                # one entry for each old one, instead of interleaving them
                for heading, src in (("Second audit — 2026-09-22", "AUDIT_2026-09-22.md"),
                                     ("First audit — 2026-07-16", "AUDIT_2026-07-16.md")):
                    earlier = _strip_lead_h1(md_to_html(
                        (ROOT / "reference" / src).read_text(encoding="utf-8")))
                    earlier = re.sub(r"<(/?)h([2-5])([^>]*)>",
                                     lambda m: f"<{m.group(1)}h{int(m.group(2)) + 1}{m.group(3)}>",
                                     earlier)
                    body += f"<h2>{heading}</h2>" + earlier
            s["html"] = body
        elif s["kind"] == "csv":
            s["html"] = df_table(pd.read_csv(ROOT / s["src"]).fillna(""), searchable=True)
        elif s["kind"] == "live":
            s["html"] = desc_html
        elif s["kind"] == "qa":
            s["html"] = qa_html
        elif s["kind"] == "overview":
            readme = md_to_html((ROOT / s["src"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            readme = _promote_tldr(_strip_lead_h1(readme))
            guide = pd.DataFrame([{"Sheet": x["title"], "Group": x["group"],
                                   "Contents": x["blurb"],
                                   "Source": x["src"] or "generated from data/final"}
                                  for x in SHEETS])
            s["html"] = (readme
                         + reading_map()
                         + "<h2>How to read this document</h2>"
                         + '<p class="note">This page is <b>generated</b> from the repository by '
                           "<code>utils/docs/build_docs.py</code>. The markdown files under "
                           "<code>reference/</code> are the canonical prose and every figure on the "
                           "Descriptives and Data QA sheets is recomputed from <code>data/final</code> "
                           "at build time — nothing here is transcribed by hand. To correct something, "
                           "edit its source and rebuild; do not edit the HTML.</p>"
                         + '<p class="note ixkey">Chips sit at the end of a figure\'s own heading, one '
                           "per affordance, and never anywhere else. " + IXBADGE
                         + " means the block has controls — click, toggle, drag or filter it. "
                         + HOVERBADGE + " means its marks carry tooltips; a block that does both "
                           "shows both. The red dot in the sidebar is <b>derived</b> from the chips "
                           "a sheet actually rendered, so the two cannot disagree. Long tables "
                           "announce themselves with a visible search box instead. Everything else "
                           "is a plain table or figure.</p>"
                         + df_table(guide)
                         + "<h2>Module index</h2>"
                         + '<p class="note">Every importable module, its version, and its purpose — '
                           "read straight from the source files. <a href='#pipeline'>Pipeline</a> "
                           "explains what each one does in context.</p>"
                         + df_table(module_index(), searchable=True))
        # the sidebar dot is READ OFF the page, never declared: a sheet is interactive iff it
        # rendered an ⇱ chip. Hand-maintained flags drifted (Place matching and Rank ladders
        # both showed a chip with no dot); a derived one cannot.
        _check_badges(s["id"], s["html"])
        s["interactive"] = '<span class="ixbadge">' in _strip_ixkey(s["html"])
        built.append(s)

    # per-script sheets go after "How it works"; index them from the Pipeline sheet
    idx = pd.DataFrame([{"Script": s["title"], "Role": s["role"], "Does": s["blurb"]}
                        for s in scripts])
    for s in built:
        if s["id"] == "pipeline":
            s["html"] = ('<h2>Script index</h2><p class="note">One sheet per module — its docstring, '
                         "public API, version, callers and git history, all read from the source. "
                         "Pick one in the sidebar under <b>Pipeline scripts</b>. The narrative below "
                         "explains how they fit together.</p>"
                         + df_table(idx, searchable=True) + "<hr>" + s["html"])
    # insert the script sheets after the LAST "How it works" sheet, so that group stays
    # contiguous in the sidebar (inserting mid-group renders its header twice)
    pos = max(i for i, s in enumerate(built) if s["group"] == "How it works") + 1
    built[pos:pos] = scripts

    # linkify inline author-year citations everywhere except the References sheet itself
    for s in built:
        if s["id"] != "references":
            s["html"] = _linkify_citations(s["html"])

    # ── the shared skeleton, applied in one place so no sheet can drift out of it ──────
    # (the contents strip used to be hand-attached to two sheets; the history wayfinder and
    # the see-also footer are new, and both are generated from the registry above)
    by_id = {s["id"]: s for s in built}
    hist = {sid for sid, *_ in _HISTORY_SHEETS}
    for s in built:
