        s["gcol"] = GROUP_COLOUR.get(s["group"], CU_GREY)
        html = s["html"]
        # script sheets already open with a chip index; everything else gets the strip
        if '<nav class="toc">' not in html and 'class="chips"' not in html:
            html = _with_toc(html, s["id"])
        # after the contents strip, so the fold lands ABOVE it: `_after_tldr` always
        # inserts immediately under the summary card, so the last caller sits highest
        fold = _plain_english(s["id"])
        if fold:
            html = _after_tldr(html, fold)
        if s["id"] in hist:
            html = _wayfind(s["id"]) + html
        s["html"] = _number_figures(html) + _seealso(s["id"], by_id)

    # A method sheet added later without a plain-English entry is silent otherwise; the
    # doorway would just stop existing for that one sheet and nobody would notice.
    ids = {s["id"] for s in built}
    for sid in sorted(PLAIN_SHEETS - set(PLAIN_ENGLISH)):
        IX_WARNINGS.append(f"{sid}: in PLAIN_SHEETS but has no PLAIN_ENGLISH entry")
    for sid in sorted(set(PLAIN_ENGLISH) - ids):
        IX_WARNINGS.append(f"{sid}: PLAIN_ENGLISH entry for a sheet that does not exist")

    groups: list[tuple[str, list[dict], bool, str]] = []
    for s in built:
        if not groups or groups[-1][0] != s["group"]:
            groups.append((s["group"], [], s["group"] == "Pipeline scripts",
                           GROUP_COLOUR.get(s["group"], CU_GREY)))
        groups[-1][1].append(s)

    lazy_anchors = _split_script_sheets(built)

    html_out = TEMPLATE.render(
        fontfaces=_font_face_css(),
        title="The Fateful Adventures of the Good Soldiers — Project Documentation",
        project="Good Soldiers", subtitle="Desertion in a volunteer army · project documentation",
        sheets=built, groups=groups, stamp=stamp, qa_failures=qa_failures,
        sheet_ids=str([s["id"] for s in built]).replace("'", '"'),
        lazy_anchors=json.dumps(lazy_anchors, ensure_ascii=False), lazy_dir=LAZY_DIR,
        pygments_css=HtmlFormatter().get_style_defs(".highlight"),
        navy=CU_NAVY, red=CU_RED, grey=CU_GREY, favicon=favicon_href(),
        # noindex meta for link-only publishing (keeps the page out of search engines);
        # set by `--noindex` or DOCS_NOINDEX=1. Off for the local/private build.
        noindex=("--noindex" in sys.argv or os.environ.get("DOCS_NOINDEX") == "1"),
    )
    # Guard: an unbalanced inline tag leaks its styling into every following sheet (a literal
    # emphasis tag named in a docstring once bolded half the document). Count per sheet, and
    # only in the body — CSS/JS text that merely *names* a tag is not markup.
    for m in re.finditer(r'<section class="sheet" id="sheet-([\w.-]+)">(.*?)</section>',
                         html_out, re.S):
        _check_balanced(m.group(1), m.group(2))

    # The bibliography travels with the page: the .bib is a projection of the same list the
    # References sheet renders, written on every build so it cannot lag behind.
    (ROOT / "reference" / "references.bib").write_text(render_bib(), encoding="utf-8")

    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    dest = OUT / "index.html"
    dest.write_text(html_out, encoding="utf-8")
    return dest


if __name__ == "__main__":
    p = main()
    mb = p.stat().st_size / 1e6
    print(f"wrote {p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()}  ({mb:.1f} MB)")
    print("math: " + ("self-contained MathML (latex2mathml)" if HAVE_MATHML else
                      "KaTeX via CDN — `pip install latex2mathml` for offline, self-contained math"))
    if MATH_WARNINGS:
        print(f"\n[!] {len(MATH_WARNINGS)} expression(s) did not convert cleanly — fix the source .md:")
        for w in MATH_WARNINGS[:10]:
            print("    " + w)
    if IX_WARNINGS:
        print(f"\n[!] {len(IX_WARNINGS)} sheet-affordance problem(s) — an interactive chip "
              f"off a heading (use ix_head), or a missing plain-English fold:")
        for w in IX_WARNINGS[:10]:
            print("    " + w)

    # The page is written either way — a broken build should still be readable, and the
    # banner says so — but the exit code reports the data's health so a script or a
    # notebook cell cannot mistake "the HTML got written" for "the invariants hold".
    from utils.validation.data_checks import run_checks as _rc
    _broken = [c for c in _rc(FIN) if not c.ok and c.hard]
    if _broken:
        print(f"\n[!] {len(_broken)} hard data invariant(s) FAILED — data/final is not safe to "
              "build on:", file=sys.stderr)
        for c in _broken:
            print(f"    - {c.label}: {c.detail}", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
